tei:div.tei:p: (365)sher phyin don bsdus theg chen lam bzang zhes bya ba// (366)rgyal ba sku bzhi'i bdag nyid nyi ma'i gnyen// rgyal tshab lha brgya'i cod paṇa mi pham pa// rgya chen shing rta thogs med yab sras sogs// rgya bod paṇa chen rnams la gus pas 'dud// mkhyen gsum sbyor bzhi chos sku la// bcu dang bcu gcig dgu bcu gcig /brgya dang bcu gsum bzhi dang bzhis// shes rab pha rol phyin pa bshad// rnam mkhyen mtshon byed chos bcu las// sems bskyed gzhan don byang chub gnyer// dbye na 'dun pa sa gzhi ltar// dkar po'i yon tan kun kyi gzhi// bsam pa gser bzhin 'gyur ba med// lhag bsam zla ba bzhin du 'phel// sbyor ba me bzhin sgrib pa bsreg /sbyin pa gter bzhin thams cad tshims// tshul khrims rin chen 'byung gnas ltar// yonatan rin po che yi rten// bzod pa rgya mtsho bzhin mi 'khrugs// brtson 'grus rdo rje ltar mi phyed// bsam gtan ri bzhin mi bskyod brtan// shes rab sman ltar sgrib gnyis zhi// thabs mkhas bshes gnyen bzang po bzhin// (367)tshad med bzhi yis gzhan don sgrub// smon lam yid bzhin nor bu bzhin// mngon shes lngas ni smon pa 'grub// stobs dang ldan pa nyi ma bzhin// bsdu dngos bzhis ni gdul bya smin// ye shes glu bzhin so so ni// yang dag rig bzhis dam chos ston// mngon shes rgyal po chen po bzhin// thogs med mthu yis gzhan don sgrub// tshogs gnyis rgyal po'i dbang mdzod bzhin// bsod nams ye shes tshogs mang gnas// byang phyogs so bdun lam chen bzhin// dus gsum 'phags pa gshegs pa'i shul// snying rje lhag mthong gzhon pa bzhin// srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das par 'gro// gzungs spobs bkod ma'i chu bo bzhin// thos dang ma thos chos kun 'dzin// chos kyi sdom bzhi sgra brnyan bzhin// thar 'dod srid las sgrol bar byed// bgrod gcig lam ni chu rgyun bzhin// gdul bya 'dul ba'i nus pa thob// chos kyi sku ni sprin chen bzhin// bcu gnyis mdzad pas 'gro rgyud smin// de ltar nyi shu rtsa gnyis las// dang po gsum ni tshogs lam gsum// sbyor ba me ni (368)sbyor ba'i lam// sbyin sogs sa bcu re re bzhin// mngon shes sogs lnga dag pa gsum// phyi ma gsum ni sangs rgyas kyi// sa yi sbyor dngos mjug gis bsdus// gnyis pa gdams ngag rnam pa bcu// sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo ni// tha snyad sgyu ma lta bu dang*// don dam stong nyid zung 'brel bas// bsam pa byang chub sems bskyed dang*// sbyor ba pha rol phyin pa drug

/gzhan don chos sku sgrub phyir gdams// sgrub pa'i dmigs yul bden pa bzhir// shes dang spang dang mngon du bya// rgyud la brten bya'i zhen 'gog ched// zag bcas 'bras gyur rgyur gyur gyi// gzugs sogs rang bzhin med pa dang*// yul can sher phyin spros pa bral// de bzhin nyid du dbyer med dang*// glo bur dri bral chos nyid dang*// phyin drug lam dang de sgrub byed// rang bzhin med par shes nas bslab// sgrub pa'i rten ni dkon mchog gsum// ston pa lam grogs zhen 'gog ched// ye shes mthar thug sangs rgyas dang*// chos rnams ngo bo nyid dang bral// phyir mi ldog rnams skye ba med// (369)grogs ni brtson 'grus gsum la gdams// snyom las le lo'i gnyen po ru// bya ba ngan la ma zhen dang*// sgyid lug le lo'i gnyen po ni// rlom pa med pas yongs mi ngal// bdag nyid brnyas pa'i le lo la// skye med lam ni yongs su 'dzin// 'bras bu spyan dang mngon shes gdams// sgrub pa gzhan dring mi 'jog rgyu/

dang po sha dang 'chi 'pho skye lha dang bdag med shes rab dang*// chos 'phags pa'i gang zag dang rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas spyan lnga bskyed// sgrub pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyu// sa g.yo rdzu 'phrul sgra chung ngu lha yi rna ba dang*// chags bcas sogs gzhan sems shes dang sngon dang gzhan gnas dran// gzugs thams cad lha yi mig dang zag pa sgrib pa spangs zad// mngon shes drug po rgyud la skye// gzhi ni mthong sgom lam la gdams// bden pa gsar du mthong ba yi// mthong lam kun btags sa bon spang*// mthong zin goms par byed pa yis// sgom lam lhan skyes sa bon spang*// de dag yul dang yul can kun// stong nyid rtogs par gyis shig ces// gdams pa 'di dag kho nas kyang*// rnam mkhyen don gnyer skyes bu yis// 'dod don rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir// (370)de ltar gdams ngag sa mtshams ni// lam la zhugs nas sangs rgyas bar// gdams ngag thams cad stong nyid kyi// rtogs pas khyad par byas pa ni// theg chen lam rnams shes rab des// zin dgos khyad par tshogs lam la// rjes thob kun rdzob lam ni bsgom// mnyam bzhag stong nyid sgom pa las// sbyor lam stong nyid la dmigs pa'i// sgom byung skye ba shes pa'i ched// rtogs dka' dge 'dun bye brag bshad// theg dman dge 'dun mtshon byed dper// byas te theg chen dge 'dun la// nyi shur dbye ba'i rgyun zhugs kyi// ming can rnam pa lnga yod de// mthong lam skad cig bcu drug gi /bar chad med lam ngo bo ni// bzod pa brgyad la gnas pa la// rgyun zhugs zhugs pa zhes brjod de// dbang brtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang*// dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang gnyis// mthong lam rnam grol lam ngo bo// shes pa brgyad la gnas pa yis// mthong spang kun sbyor gsum zad par// spangs la 'bras gnas tsam po ba// 'dod nyon gsum pa spangs ba yi// rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par (371)can// mi yi rigs nas rigs skye dang*// lha yi rigs nas rigs skye gnyis// phyir 'ong ming can gsum yod de// 'dod nyon drug pa spang la phyogs// phyir 'ong zhugs pa dad mthong thob// 'dod nyon drug pa spang ba yi// phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po ba// 'dod nyon brgyad pa spang ba yi// phyir 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can// bar chad gcig pa'i ming can no// phyir mi 'ong ba bcu yod de// 'dod nyon dgu pa spang la phyogs// phyir mi 'ong zhugs dbang po ni// rno rtul dad dang mthong thob ces// gnyis su yod kyang gcig tu bsgrangs// gzugs kyi bar srid kyi rten la// nyon sgrib ci rigs spangs ba yi// rnam grol lam ni thob pa la// bar dor 'da' dang gzugs khams su// skyes nas 'da' dang byed bcas dang*// 'du byed med par 'da' dang bzhi// 'og min rten la nyon sgrib ni// ci rigs spangs ba'i rnam grol lam// mngon du byed pa'i byang 'phags la// 'phar ba phyed 'phar gnas kun tu// 'chi 'pho ba yi ming can gsum// gzugs med skye ba mi gnyer yang*// srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro zhes btags//

(372)gzugs kyi 'dod chags ci rigs dang*// bral ba'i byang sems de la ni// mthong ba'i chos la zhi ba dang*// 'gog snyoms thob pa'i lus mngon byed// nyon sgrib spong ba'i rnam grol lam// thob phyir brtson pa'i sa bcu pa// dgra bcom zhugs pa'i ming can dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu par// bse ru rang rgyal ming can bcas// gsum pa sbyor ba'i lam la gsum// spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i// de bzhin nyid la dmigs nas kyang*// 'dzin stangs kyis ni rnam pa yang*// mtha' dang spros pa'i rang bzhin gang*// med pas spros pa gang dang gang*// bcad pa'i cha nas dbye ba ste// de lta'i gnad ni ma go bar// res 'ga'i 'dzin stangs can du sems// des ni sher phyin dgongs don zab// phyogs tsam shes par dka' ba yin// 'jam mgon mi pham pa yis gsungs// nyan rang dag gi sbyor lam las// dmigs rnam rgyu yi khyad par ni// drod la chung 'bring chen po gsum// dmigs pa mi rtag sogs bcu drug rnam pa mngon par zhen pa 'gog /rgyu ni theg gsum rtogs rigs tshang*// theg chen mthong lam 'thob byed pa// de bzhin gzugs (373)sogs 'du 'god dam// skye 'jig bral ba'i bden bzhi la// ming 'jug bral dang rigs 'dra gnas// ming tsam khyad par byas pa la// brjod du med par rtogs pa'o// rtse mo la yang rnam pa gsum// gzugs sogs mi gnas pa de yi// ngo bo rang bzhin med pa dang*// de dag stong nyid rang bzhin gcig /mi rtag rnam par mi gnas rtogs// mi rtag pa dang stong nyid rnams// ngo bos stong pa'i gcig pa la// bdag gir mi 'dzin gzung byas stong*// sngo ser mtshan ma bral ba la// dmigs su med par rtogs pa'o// bzod pa la yang dmigs rnam gsum// gzugs sogs ngo bo med pa la// tha snyad ngo bo nyid du rtogs// gzugs sogs 'khor 'das bden maid la// dmigs nas sgo gsum dag pa dang*// mtshan bzang zhing dag thob pa'i rgyur// rang spyi'i mtshan ma med pa la// mos pas mtshan mar bzung bya min// mtshan mar 'du shes byar med pa'o// chos mchog la yang dmigs rnam gsum// dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin la// de yi byed pa gzhan gyi don// lhun gyis grub pa'i 'bras bur rtogs// gang (374)gi rang bzhin rtogs pa na// sangs rgyas lung bstan byed pa'i rgyur// 'khor gsum rloms pa zad pa'o// chos nyid spros pa bral ba'i ngor// 'khor gsum ngo bo gcig pa la// 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog lam// byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs dam pa// nyid du rtogs pa rnam pa'o// de las ngo bo nyid la sogs// dmigs bsal can gsum ma gtogs pa// gzhan dgu chos nyid rnam pa yin// spang bya rtogs pa'i khyad par la// shes sgrib kun nyon gzung rtog ni// rmongs pa nyon mongs can ma rig

/zag pa bcas pa'i phung po dang*// ming dang gzugs la bdag dang ni// bdag gir 'dzin pa'i 'jig lta dang*// rtag chad mthar chags mthar lta dang*// kun byang blang dor mi dad pa// 'phags lam mi spro le lo dang*// tshor ba bde sdug bar ma gsum// bdag gzhan 'dzin pas chags dang sdang*// sdug bsngal gyis ni sdug bsngal te// spang bya'i yul dgu la dmigs nas// longs su spyad byar 'dzin pa dgu rnam byang phyogs kyi gzung rtog dgu// rnam byang bskyed par byed pa yi// du ma spungs pa'i phung po dang*// bdag rkyen gyur pa'i skye mched dang*// nyer len gyur pa'i khams dang ni// rnam (375)byang rten 'brel lugs ldog dang*// spros pa bral ba'i stong pa nyid// theg chen spyod pa phar phyin drug /shes bzod bcu drug mthong ba'i lam// bsam gzugs ngo bo sgom pa'i lam// bslab pa yongs rdzogs mi slob lam// blang bya'i yul dgu la dmigs nas// longs su spyad byar 'dzin pa'o// 'dzin rtog la yang gnyis yod de// gang zag rdzas yod 'dzin pa la// phung po rang dbang bdag dang ni// zla med gcig pur 'dzin pa dang*// skye mched rnam shes 'byed pa'i rgyur// de bzhin khams dang kun nyon dang*// 'jig rten lam gyi chags bral dang*// bden bzhi'i chos nyid mthong ba'i lam// rnam thar mthar gnas sgom pa'i lam// slob pa'i mthar thug mi slob lam// kun la rang dbang bdag tu 'dzin// de la dmigs nas de'i yul la// longs su spyod byed 'dzin pa dgu// skyes bu btags 'dzin rtog pa la// gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po lnga// mig sogs skye mched bcu gnyis dang*// gzugs kyi khams sogs bco brgyad dang*// rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis dang*// byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun// rnam thar sgo gsum mthong ba'i (376)lam// bsam gzugs ngo bo sgaum pa'i lam// stong nyid rtogs pa'i khyad par lam// stobs bcu la sogs mi slob lam// de dgu kun byang chos rnams kyi// gdags gzhi la brten btags par 'dzin// de la dmigs nas de'i yul la// longs su spyod byed 'dzin pa'o// 'di dag bden grub 'dzin pa ni// rjes thob nges pa'i ngor yang ldog

/btags tsam mtshan mar zhen pa ni// mnyam bzhag stobs kyis ldog pas na// de rnams sbyor lam rang dus su// mngon 'gyur mgo gnon rang 'bras ni// mthong lam rtse sbyor spang bya yin// yongs 'dzin khyad par rnam gsum las// thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par ni// 'jigs pa'i gnas min stong nyid la// 'jigs pa'i gnyen por stong nyid la// mi 'gong mi skrag par byed dang*// chos ston khyad par bsam pa bzhin// bdag med gnyis dang phyin drug lam// 'gal rkyen spang ba'i khyad par ni// ser sna la sogs mi mthun phyogs// 'dor bar byed du 'jug pa'o// theg chen lam rdzogs 'doms nus pa'i// thabs mkhas ldan pa'i bshes gnyen gyis// ji srid sangs rgyas ma 'thob bar// srid zhir ltung las 'dzin pa ni// yongs su 'dzin pa'i khyad (377)par yin// bzhi pa rigs ni sems can gyi// sems kyi chos nyid chos kyi dbyings// dbye na sbyor lam nges 'byed bzhi// mthong sgom rtogs pa'i chos drug dang*// bar chad med lam skye ba dang*// spang bya spong la mngon phyogs gnyis// de spangs rnam grol lam dang ni// sa brgyad shes rab snying brtser bcas// sa dgu'i so so rig bzhi dang*// sa bcu'i gzhan don sangs rgyas mthun// ji lta ji snyed rtsol med 'jug /rten chos sgrub pa bcu gsum gyis// dbye ba'i rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs// rdza bum snod du sbrang rtsi dang*// li kha ra dang zho sogs bcud// mi 'dra'i dbang gis de dang de'i// snod ces so sor 'jog pa bzhin// lnga pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni// sgro 'dogs bcad bya'i gzhi bcu gcig /dbye na blang bya'i dge ba dang*// dor bya mi dge btang snyoms su// bzhag bya lung ma bstan dang gsum// blang bya dge ba de la yang*// so skye'i rgyud 'brel 'jig rten dang*// 'phags rgyud bsdus pa'i 'das pa'i lam// 'das pa'i lam des spang bya ni// bdag lta'i zag bcas phung po dang*// gnyen po zag pa (378)med pa'i chos// gnyen po dngos dang bral 'bras ni// 'dus byas lam gyi bden pa dang*// 'dus ma byas pa 'gog pa'i bden// 'gog lam gnyis kyi yon tan la// 'phags rgyud nyan thos thun mong chos// thub dbang kho na'i thun min chos// rim pa de ltar dpyad dgos so// drug pa ched du bya ba ni// sgrub la 'jug pa'i 'bras bu mchog

/de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje che// sgrib gnyis bag chags spang ba che// shes bya kun mkhyen rtogs pa che// chen po gsum gyis bsdus pa'o// bdun pa go cha'i sgrub pa ni// phyogs dus kun nas dpag dka' ba'i// go char gyur pa'i snying stobs ni// bsam pa rgya chen gyis zin pa// phyin drug re re'i nang du ni// drug drug tshang bar bsdus pa ste// dbye na so drug sa mtshams ni// tshogs lam nas bzung rgyun mtha'i bar// brgyad pa 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ni// sbyor ba rgya ches brtson 'grus brtsams// dbye na rnam pa dgu yod de// bsam gzugs brgyad ni lam gyi rten// nyams len sbyin sogs phar phyin drug /lam gyi ngo bo mthong sgom dang*// grogs ni byams sogs tshad (379)med bzhi// mnyam bzhag dmigs med stong nyid lta// de bzhin 'jig rten 'das pa'i lam// rjes ni 'khor gsum dag pa dang*// ched du bya ba chen po gsum// mthu ni mngon par shes pa drug /gsum ni theg pa dman las 'phags// 'bras bu rnam mkhyen chos 'khor bskor// de dag mi zhum par 'jug pa// sa mtshams drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar// dgu pa tshogs kyi sgrub pa ni// sbyor ba nyams len la zhugs pas// tshogs gnyis dpung tshogs rgya che 'byung*// de yi dbang gis mtha' gnyis las// nges 'byung mi gnas myang 'das 'grub// dbye na bcu bdun yod pa las// bsam pa sdug bsngal bral 'dod pa'i// snying rje chen po'i tshogs sgrub dang*// sbyor ba tshe 'di'i bde ba la// 'god pa sbyin pa'i tshogs sgrub dang*// phyi ma mngon mtho'i bde ba la// 'god pa tshul khrims tshogs sgrub dang*// ting 'dzin la bkod gcig tu nges// bde sgrub bzod brtson bsam gtan tshogs// nges par legs pa gtan du ba'i// bde sgrub shes rab kyis ni tshogs// mnyam bzhag rtse gcig zhi gnas dang*// dpyad stobs sgom byung lhag (380)mthong dang*// de dag zung du 'brel ba'i lam// rjes thob gzhan don thabs la mkhas// lta ba stong nyid ye shes tshogs// spyod pa gzhan don bsod nams tshogs// yon tan sgrub byed mthong sogs lam// dmigs pa mi brjed gzungs kyi tshogs// sa yi tshogs dang gnyen po'i tshogs// de las bsod nams tshogs zhes pa// spyir ni dge ba'i las yin kyang*// zag med dge dang khyad par du// dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang*// rin chen phyag rgya la sogs pa// mdo las gsungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin// 'di dag stobs las bsod nams tshogs// dpag med skad cig re res kyang*// tshad maid par ni sgrub pa'i phyir// 'di dag byang chen 'byin byed tshogs// sgrub tshul bden gnyis nyams len las// mi 'da'i sgo nas sgrub pa yin// byang sems nyams len zab rgyas lam// thams cad 'di dag gis bsdus so// sa mtshams chos mchog nas rgyun mtha'// phyi ma gnyis ni bye brag bshad// yongs sbyong bcu yis sa dang por// skyon zad yon tan rdzogs par byed// rang don med pa'i lhag bsam dang*// theg pa (381)chen po'i chos ni 'dzin// tshad med bzhi yi sems mnyam nyid// ser sna med pas bdog pa gtong*// dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten// theg pa gsum gyi dam chos tshol// nges 'byung ldan par rab tu byung*// sangs rgyas rjes dran dang mi 'bral// dpe 'khyud med pa'i dam chos ston// bden pa'i tshig ni smra bar byed// 'di dag shes rab snying rjes zin// sa gnyis pa la yongs sbyong brgyad// tshul khrims rnam gsum yongs su dag

/gzhan gyi phan par byas pa gzo// gnod pa byed la bzod pa skyed// dge ba sgrub la 'gyod med spro// bskal mang sdug bsngal mi skyo brtse// skye bo kun la bkur stis 'dud// bla ma la gus gsung bzhin sgrub// sbyin sogs phar phyin drug la brtson// sa gsum pa la yongs sbyong lnga// dam chos thos pas mi ngoms brtson// rnyed bkur med par chos sbyin 'bad// zhing khams rnam par dag pa sbyong*// bzod pas 'khor ba yongs mi skyo// ngo tsha khrel yod rlom pa med// sa bzhi pa la yongs sbyong bcu// 'du 'dzis dben pa'i nags su gnas// (382)gzhan gyi nor la 'dod pa chung*// rang gi nor la chog shes ldan// sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis brten// bslab pa srog gi phyir mi gtong*// 'dod yon nyes pa mthong nas spang*// gdul bya skal ba 'tsham par bkri// lus dang longs spyod yongs su gtong*// brtson pas dge la sems mi 'khum// bden pa'i mtshan mar lta ba med// sa lnga pa la yongs sbyong bcu// nyes dmigs can gyi spang bya ni// rnyed bkur sred pas kun dang 'dris// phrag dog bsam pas rab byung la// dad pa can gyi khyim mi ston// 'du 'dzir gyur pa'i gnas su sdod// bdag la bstod cing gzhan la brnyas// mi dge bcu ni lhag par 'phel// rlom pas gzhan la mi 'dud dang*// dge sdig blang dor phyin ci log /'jig dang log dang mthar lta ba// chags sogs nyon mongs mi spang ba// de dag gnyen po yongs su brten// drug par yongs sbyong bcu gnyis te// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan sa lnga yan la rdzogs// shes rab sa 'dir lhag (383)par rdzogs// gnyen po phar phyin drug po des// spang bya drug ni spang ba ste// nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal gyi// byang chub 'thob 'dod spang ba dang*// stong pa nyid la skrag pa spang*// bslangs na sems ni mi zhum dang*// bdog kun btang yang mi dga' med// dbul yang slong ba mi spang ngo*// sa bdun spang bya nyi shu ni// bdag dang sems can 'dzin pa dang*// srog dang gang zag 'dzin pa dang*// chad par 'dzin dang rtag par 'dzin// mtshan mar 'dzin dang rigs sam rgyu// tha dad par ni 'dzin pa dang*// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// khams gsum gnas su 'dzin pa dang*// de nyid dor byar 'dzin pa dang*// sems ni kun tu zhum pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum dang tshul khrims la// bden par mngon par zhen pa dang*// stong pa nyid la rtsod pa dang*// stong dang rten 'byung 'gal bar rtsod// de la gnyen po nyi shu ni// rim pa bzhin du shes par bya// chos rnams ngo bo stong pa nyid// rgyu la mtshan ma med pa dang*// 'bras bu smon pa med pa yi// rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang*// 'khor gsum rang bzhin rnam par dag

/yun ring sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i// sems (384)can rnams la snying rje ldan// chos rnams rang bzhin nam du yang*// mi 'dor ba yi rlom pa med// chos rnams gdod nas mnyam pa nyid// sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya bas// mthar thug theg pa chen por gcig /chos rnams skye ba med pa dang*// zab mo'i don la mi skrag bzod// chos rnams mi dmigs pa la gcig /'khor ba'i mngon zhen thams cad 'joms// gtsang sogs 'du shes phyin ci log /'jig lta la sogs lta ngan dang*// chags sogs nyon mongs rnam par spong*// yon tan rten du zhi gnas sgrub// lhag mthong snying rje sogs la mkhas// chos la zhen pa'i khengs pa dang*// bral bas zhi zhing dul ba dang*// chos la thogs med ye shes ldan// gang yang chags pa'i gnas min shes// gang 'dod sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro// 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor kun tu yang*// lus ni blo dang 'tsham par ston// sa brgyad pa la yongs sbyong brgyad// sems can kun kyi sems shes dang*// zhing khams kun tu bgrod pa dang*// zhing khams bzang por sgrub pa dang*// sangs rgyas thams cad bsten pa dang*// dbang po mchog dman shes pa dang*// bcud (385)rnams dag par sgrub pa dang*// sgyu ma lta bur gnas pa dang*// bsam bzhin srid pa len pa'o// sa dgur yongs sbyong bcu gnyis te// smon lam thams cad 'grub pa dang*// lha la sogs pa'i skad shes dang*// spobs pa chu bo lta bu dang*// mngal gyi mchog ni 'jug pa dang*// rgyal rigs sogs su skye ba dang*// bu ram shing sogs rus bzang dang*// gnyen bzang brgyud ma'i cho 'brang dang*// rang dbang btub pa'i 'khor bzang dang*// rtags mtshan ngo mtshar snang bzhin skye/ khyim nas nges par 'byung ba dang*// a shwattha 'dra'i byang chub shing*// stobs sogs phal cher sangs rgyas 'dra// sa bcu pa ni 'da' bya yi// sa dgu 'das pa'i ye shes nyid// de la 'da' bya'i sa dgu ni// nyan rang sbyor lam rigs kyi sa// rgyun zhugs zhugs pa brgyad pa'i sa// rgyun zhugs rtogs pa mthong ba'i sa// phyir 'ong rtogs pa bsrab pa'i sa// phyir mi 'ong ni chags bral sa// nyan thos dgra bcom byas rtogs sa// zhugs pa gzhan gsum nyan thos sa// rang sangs rgyas kyi rang rgyal sa//

(386)rab tu dga' sogs sa dgu la// byang sems sa zhes gcig tu brtsi// dman pa shes mthong bltas nas dang*// byang sa gnas nas rim gyis 'da'// gnyen po tshogs kyi sgrub pa ni// mthong dang sgom pa'i lam dag la// rang rang ngo skal spang bya ni// shes sgrib kun nyon gzung rtog dang*// rnam byang gzung rtog rnam pa gnyis// gang zag rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*// skyes bu btags 'dzin rtog pa ste// de bzhin kun btags lhan skyes kyi// phye bas brgyad du yod pa de// kun btags bzhi yi sa bon gyi// gnyen po mthong lam bar chad med// lhan skyes gnyen po sgom lam gyi// bar chad med lam bzhi dang brgyad// bcu pa nges 'byung sgrub pa ni// gong du bshad pa'i sems bskyed sogs// dgu po mthar phyin sgrub pa la// brten nas mthar thug 'byung sa brgyad// nges par 'byung la nges 'byung sgrub// yin te byang chub sems dpa' yi// sgrub pa khyad par can gyis ni// mthar 'bras mi gnas myang 'das la// sgrib pa'i phyogs kun las 'das nas// byang chub chen por nges 'byung phyir// dbye na rnam pa brgyad yod (387)de// thob bya mthar thug yin pas spyir// ched du bya ba chen po gsum// ched du nges par 'byung ba dang*// shes rab chen po mthar phyin pas// chos kun mnyam pa nyid du gzigs// de las nam yang mi g.yo dang*// dmigs med snying rje yongs smin pas// sbyor ba sems can don mtha' yas// 'bad rtsol med par lhun grub 'byung*// de gsum sems kyi khyad par dang*// mtha' gnyis mi gnas mya ngan 'das// spang bya zad pas theg gsum gyi// rtogs rigs thob pa'i mtshan nyid can// gnyis ni spang ba chen po'i khyad// chos bcu mngon rtogs rnam kun mkhyen// de bdun rnam grol lam yon tan// de rgyu rdor ting bar rtsi ni// lam gyi yon tan nges 'byung ste// rtogs pa chen po'i ngo bo rgyu// sa mtshams dag pa'i sa gsum mo// go sgrub sogs bzhi'i rgyu mtshan ni// dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa'i tshe// dang por sra ba'i go bgos nas// g.yul ngor zhugs te dpung tshogs bshams// dgra sde las ni rgyal byed bzhin// 'dir yang phyin drug go cha bgos// sbyor ba drag pos nyams su blangs// tshogs gnyis dpung gi grogs dang bcas// mthar ni bdud (388)bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal// rnam mkhyen nges par 'byung bas so//

/skabs dang po'o// rnam mkhyen thob byed lam shes la// mtshaun byed chos ni bcu gcig las// dang po lam shes yan lag la// 'dod gzugs lha rnams ston pa'i drung*// lhags tshe rang bzhin gyi 'od kyis// rnam smin 'od rnams mog mog por// mdzad nas nga rgyal bcom pa ni// 'gal rkyen bral ba'i khyad par dang*// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// skye ba'i rten ni nges pa ni// lhan cig byed rkyen khyad par dang*// sems can rnams la sangs rgyas rigs// yod phyir nyer len rgyu yi khyad// de ni lam shes skye ba'i rten// 'dod srid zag pas bsdus pa yi// nyon mongs rang don mi spang bar// gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu// sgyur cing 'khor ba mi 'dor ba// rang bzhin gyi ni khyad par dang*// rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ma byas par// yang dag mtha' mngon mi byed dang*// shes rab snying rje'i thabs mkhas pas// sems can smin grol 'god par byed// de ni byed las khyad par yin// gnyis pa nyan thos lam shes ni// sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa la// rgyu rkyen (389)las skyes mi rtag pa// las nyon gzhan dbang sdug bsngal ba// don gzhan bdag gis stongs pa dang*// rang gi ngo bo bdag med pa// kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa ni// sdug bsngal rtsa bar gyur pas rgyu// yang yang bskyed pas kun 'byung ba// shugs drag skyed pas rab tu skye// yang srid phyi ma'i rkyen byed de// sdug kun thun mong rnam pa ni// phyir rgol gnod pas dgra lta bu// gnod byed 'jigs pas 'jigs pa dang*// ring du mi gnas g.yo ba dang*// ngang gis 'jigs pas rab tu 'jigs// 'di phyir gnod pa'i gnas su 'jigs// sems yod gnod pas 'gos nad ltar// sems med gnod pas nyer 'tshe'o// 'gog pa'i bden pa'i rnam pa ni// nyon mongs spangs ba'i bral bas 'gog /sdug bsngal zhi ba'i bral bas zhi// gtsang bde'i ngo bor gyur pa yi// bral ba yin pas gya nom pa// ngo bo rgyu 'bras gsum dang ni// mngon par 'du byed pa rnams dang*// bral bas nges 'byung rnam pa'o// lam gyi bden pa'i rnam pa ni// thar par phyin byed yin pas lam// nyon (390)mongs dngos gnyen byed pas rigs// gnas lugs mngon du rtogs pas sgrub// sdug bsngal gtan zad byed pas na// nges par 'byin pa'i rnam pa'o// de dag sbyor ba sems bskyed dang*// dngos gzhi dmigs med rjes bsngo bas// zin pa'i sgo nas sbyor lam skabs// don spyi'i tshul du mthong lam skabs// mngon sum rtogs par bya ba yin// dgos pa 'khor bar yid 'byung nas// thar par yid ches rnyed pa dang*// nyan thos rigs can rjes bzung phyir// sa mtshams mthong lam nas bzung ste// sangs rgyas sa yi bar du yod// de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun ni// gzugs sogs rang bzhin stong pa'i phyir// stong dang gzugs sogs dbyer med pas// zin pa'i mi rtag sogs rtogs pa'i// ye shes sbyor lam drod yin no// de yi ye shes gong 'phel du// gzugs sogs mi dmigs pas rtse mo// gzugs sogs rtag dang mi rtag tshul// gnas pa bkag pa'i bzod thob pas// zin pa sbyor lam bzod pa dang*// sa bcu dag las brtsams nas ni// mi gnas tshul ni sher mdo las// rgyas par bstan pas zin pa ni// sbyor lam chos mchog (391)ye shes yin// 'dir ni dngos bstan stong nyid rtogs// sbyor lam yin la nyan thos kyi// lam shes pa yi lam shes rgyu// theg chen sbyor lam shugs bstan gyi// gtso dang nyan thos sbyor lam ni// shugs bstan phal pa yin pas so// gsum pa rang rgyal lam shes la// rang rgyal srid pa tha ma'i tshe// gzhan la ma ltos rang stobs kyis// rang gis byang chub rtogs pa dang*// gdul bya gzhan la chos ston tshe// ngag gi rnam rig ltos min par// lus kyi rdzu 'phrul sgo nas ni// sngon gyi smon lam mthus ston nus// gzung ba rang bzhin med rtogs phyir// nyan thos rnams las khyad par 'phags// 'dzin pa bden med ma rtogs phyir// theg pa che las dman par bzhag

/'dis ni rnam gzhag rten rang rgyal// yin yang byang sems kyi rgyud la// sgom tshul sa mtshams gong dang 'dra// 'o na rang rgyal de'i ye shes// rgyu med 'gyur snyam dogs pa'am// spyir ni rang byung gi ye shes// yin na de la rgyu med pas// lam gyis sgrub tu mi rung ngam// yang na lam la ma goms kyang*// de nyid mngon du 'gyur snyam na// (392)dmigs pa mtha' dag zhi ba yi// ye shes de ni zab don la// bzod pa'i lam gyi sher phyin 'dir// ma brten mngon du mi 'gyur te// glo bur dri mas bsgribs pa yin// de nyid ma bsal mi snang phyir// de bzhin nyid dang dbyer med par// gshegs pa'i rang byung gi ye shes// mthar thug pa ni lta ci smros// dman lam gyis thob de bzhin nyid// sgrib pa ci rigs dag pa yang*// dngos por lta ba bcad stong pa'i// nyi tshe'i don la bzod pa'am// blos lcogs pa yi sher phyin gyi// rigs su gtogs pa'i mthus yin par// bstan na rang sangs rgyas la yang*// bdag med phyed gnyis sngon goms rgyus// srid pa tha mar gyur pa na// gzhan gyis bstan pa med na yang*// de ltar rtogs par 'thad pa ni// don gyis bstan pa mdzad pa yin// gzung ba med la 'dzin pa ni// yod par 'dod 'di ji ltar na// rmi lam sgyu ma'i snang ba la// snang yul ngo bos ma grub kyang*// 'dzin par der snang mi khegs bzhin// de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun ni// tha snyad btags pa tsam gyis chos// ston la mkhas kyang don dam (393)par// brjod med chos nyid rig pa des// chos nyid dang 'gal mi 'gyur ba// chos ston spyod pa sbyor lam drod// chos rnams 'phel 'grib med pa sogs/ khyad par byas pa rtse mo'o// nang gi stong pa nyid la sogs// rtogs pa gzugs sogs mi'adzin bzod// gzugs sogs skye 'gags med sogs kyi// rnam pa can ni chos mchog go

/'dis ni stong nyid rnam pa can// bstan pas gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis// stong pa'i sbyor lam bzhi la yang*// stong nyid rtogs pas zin dgos phyir// bzhi pa theg chen mthong lam la// mnyam rjes gnyis las mnyam bzhag la// ji lta ji snyed rtogs pa gnyis// ji lta rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag gis// bya rdzogs skad cig gcig la ni// bzod shes skad cig bcu drug skye// de yang bar chad med lam des// yul gyi chos nyid rtogs pa'i cha// chos bzod bzhi dang yul can gyi// chos nyid rtogs la rjes bzod bzhi// rnam grol lam des yul yul can// rtogs la chos shes rjes shes brgyad// ngo bo gcig (394)la ldog pas dbye// sdug bsngal bden pa'i de bzhin nyid// de nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dag /phan tshun rten dang brten pa yi// rang bzhin med par rtogs pa ni// mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod yin// yul can sher phyin phan yon cher// rtogs pa sdug bsngal chos shes dang*// 'jal byed tshad ma mi dmigs pa// sdug bsngal rjes bzod rnam pa dang*// mkha' ltar tshad med par rtogs pa// sdug bsngal rjes shes rnam pa'o// kun 'byung sogs la de bzhin bzhi// yod med mtha' bral rtogs pa dang*// gzugs sogs sangs rgyas nges par 'dzin// blang med dor ba med pa dang*// byams sogs tshad med sgom pa bzhi// gzugs sogs stong nyid rtogs pa dang*// 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob pa dang*// gnyen po rnam byang kun bsdus dang*// phyi nang 'tshe ba kun sel bzhi// myang 'das der zhen zhi ba dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis srung ba dang*// dge la gnas te gzhan der bkod// dge rtsa rdzogs byang bsngo dang bzhi// de ltar chos rnams mnyam pa nyid// mthong ba'i ye shes des bden bzhi'i// chos (395)nyid ji bzhin gzigs pa yin// 'di dag spang bya'i sa bon gyi// dngos gnyen 'byed pa'i sgo nas bzhag

/stong nyid mngon sum rtogs pa ni// 'da' byed mthong lam mi rtag sogs// bcu drug mngon sum rtogs pa ni// 'da' bya'i mthong lam skye tshul yang*// mnyam bzhag rjes thob skabs su 'byung*// lnga pa sgom lam byed pa ni// phan yon rnam pa drug yod de// rang sems rang dbang gyur pa dang*// skye bo kun la 'dud pa dang*// sems la nyon mongs med pa dang*// dug sogs gnod pas mi brdzi dang*// rang stobs byang chub sgrub pa dang*// de gnas yul de gzhan gyis mchod// dang po bzhi ni gnas skabs dang*// lnga pa mthar thug byed pa ste// de lnga rang byung gtogs pa dang*// drug pa gzhan rgyud gtogs pa yin// sa mtshams sgom lam skad cig ni// gnyis nas sangs rgyas bar du yod// drug pa mos pa sgom lam ni// mnyam bzhag sher phyin sgom stobs kyis// rjes thob gzhung lam 'bras bu yi// sher phyin gsum la rang don dang*// gnyis don gzhan don 'byung gnas su// yid ches mos pa (396)sgom lam ste// sa bdun man chad rang don dang*// brgyad dang dgu par gnyis don dang*// bcu pa gzhan don kho na la// yum gsum don gsum 'byung gnas su// yid ches mos pa sgom lam gsum// yan lag dbye na chung 'bring ches// gsum gsum de la nying lag gi /dbye bas nyi shu rtsa bdun la// gling bzhi dge la bkod pa sogs// mdo las phan yon nyair bdun yod// bdun pa mos pa'i phan yon la// bstod bkur bsngags gsum 'byung ba ni// sgom lam byang sems de la ni// sangs rgyas byang sems gong ma rnams// thugs dgyes pa dang don gnas kyi// yon tan brjod par mdzad pa yin// rang don mos par bstod pa dgu// gnyis don mos par bkur ba dgu// gzhan don mos par bsngags pa dgu// sa mtshams mos pa sgom lam gyi// skad cig gnyis nas sangs rgyas bar// 'dis ni mtshon pa tsam yin pas// bsngo ba yi rang la yang sbyar// brgyad pa bsngo ba'i sgom lam ni// shes rab snying rjes zin pa yi// rang gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba kun// bla med byang chub rgyur bsngo ba// de la rnam grangs bcu gnyis yod// nyan rang sogs las khyad par 'phags// spyi dang bye

(397)brag 'khor gsum dag /bsngo bya'i rdzas la zhen pa 'gog /bsngo byed sems la zhen pa gcod// bsngo ba po la zhen pa 'gog /don dam bsngos yin kun rdzob tu// bsngo bya sangs rgyas tshogs rjes dran// rnam mkhyen yid byed kyis zin pa'i// phar phyin drug dang ldan pa grogs// de la 'khor gsum bden zhen 'gog /yon tan sangs rgyas rjes su gnang*// 'bras bu khams gsum la mi gtogs// chung 'bring che gsum dbye ba ni// stong gsum sems can dge bcur bkod// de dag rgyun zhugs sogs la bkod// de rnams bla med byang chub bkod// dgu pa yi rang sgom lam ni// rang gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba la// phrag dog med par dga' ba sgom// de la kun rdzob sgyu ma ltar// don dam dmigs med shes rab kyis// zin dang mtshungs ldan dang ba'i dad// rnam pa can gyi yi rang gnyis// dge rtsa gsog dang rdzogs byang rgyur// gong nas gong du spel byed pa'i// mos bsngo yi rang sa mtshams ni// dang po'i sa nas rgyun mtha'i bar// sgra don 'dres 'dzin rtog bcas chos// (398)'di dag zag bcas zhes su brjod// bcu pa sgrub pa sgom lam ni// mnyam bzhag rang gi ngo bo ste// spros bral mngon sum rtogs pa dang*// des zin pa yi sbyin sogs dang*// kun la mngon par 'du mi byed// gnas skabs dmigs med rgyud la gtod// mthar thug 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid// bcu gcig rnam dag sgom lam la// mthun pa'i rkyen dang 'gal rkyen ni// sangs rgyas mang po bsten pa dang*// bskal mang phyin drug spyad pa dang*// zhi lhag zung 'brel thabs mkhas ldan// 'di la mos pa'i rgyu dag yin// chos kyis phongs pa'i rgyu dag ni// bdud kyi 'thib pos non pa dang*// stong pa nyid la mi mos dang*// phung sogs mngon par zhen pa dang*// sdig pa'i grogs pos zin pa'o// rnam dag sgom lam ngo bo ni// zag med bar chad med lam gyi// 'bras bu rnam grol lam de la// gnas pa'i rgyud kyi dag pa nyid// yul can dag pa'i rtogs pa ni// yul gzugs sogs kyi dag pa yin// de dag tha dad med pas so// de yi rgyu mtshan blo la yang*// bden par zhen dang gnyis snang gi

/ (399)mtshan zhen sgrib pa dag tshul las// theg gsum rtogs rigs 'bras bur bzhag /yul can de ltar dag pa'i tshe// mig skyon dag pa'i mthong ba bzhin// yul gyi rang bzhin ji lta ba// mthong phyir yul yang dag par snang*// de gnyis tha dad ma yin te// blo ni dag pa yul rang gi /rang bzhin mthong ba'i dbang gis yin// yul gyi dag pa rang bzhin gyis// de ltar gnas pa nyid yin phyir// blo des dag par bcos pa min// don du chos rnams ye gzod nas// rnam dag chen po sgrib bral gyi// bdag nyid du ni gnas zin yang*// dung nyid dkar po yin na yang*// mig ser can gyis ser snang ltar// phyin ci log gis blo bslad nas// phyin ci log tu dmigs pa nyid// yang dag lam gyis rim sbyangs nas// dngos po'i gnas tshul dag pa nyid// rim gyis mthong ba yin pas so// nyon mongs sgrib tsam spang ba yi// dag pa nyan thos dgra bcom dang*// nyon sgrib shes sgrib gzung rtog tsam// spangs ba'i dag pa rang rgyal dang*// nyon (400)shes 'dzin pa ci rigs pa// spang ba byang sems sgom lam pa// sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'gog lam ni// sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa// spangs ba'i rnam dag shin tu ba// de dag 'phags bzhi'i rnam dag go khams gsum sa dgu la brten pa'i// gzung 'dzin rnam rtog chen po yi// chen po nas bzung dri ma dgu// bar chad med lam chung ngu yi// chung ngu la sogs gnyen po dgus// spang la klan ka mi 'jug ste// don dam spang gnyen che chung sogs// ma grub kun rdzob tu 'thad par// gos la dri ma bkru ba'i tshul// btso blag mkhan gyi 'bad rtsol bzhin// sgom lam mnyam bzhag ye shes ni// 'jal byed shes dang gzhal bya yul// spros bral mnyam pa nyid rtogs pas/ khams gsum sgom spang mtha' dag spong*// sgrub dang rnam dag sa mtshams ni// dang po'i sa nas bcu pa'i bar/ skabs gnyis pa'o//

lam shes yan lag gzhi shes ni// gzhi shes sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gzhir// phung khams skye mched chos kun yin// de rnams gang zag bdag gis stong*// de shes nyan thos pa'i rtogs pa// bdag gnyis kyis stong spros bral du// shes pa theg chen rtogs pa'o// phyi ma (401)dngos bstan snga ma ni// shugs las mtshaun pa'i gzhi shes la// mtshon byed chos ni rnam dgu las// dang po shes pas srid pa la// mi gnas pa yi gzhi shes ni// mi rtag la sogs mngon sum du// rtogs pa'i theg chen mthong ba'i lam// gnyis pa snying rjes zhi ba la// mi gnas pa yi gzhi shes ni// byang 'phags rgyud kyi snying rje dang*// kun rdzob sems bskyed lta bu'o// de gnyis sa mtshams theg chen gyi// mthong lam nas ni sangs rgyas bar// gsum pa 'bras yum la ring ba'i// gzhi shes snying rje chen po dang*// bral zhing 'dzin pas bcings ba'i phyir// 'bras yum sgrub byed thabs ma yin// sa mtshams theg dman mthong lam nas// de yi mi slob bar du yod// bzhi pa nye ba'i gzhi shes ni// snying rje che dang stong pa nyid// mngon sum rtogs pas zin pa'i phyir// 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas nyid// sa mtshams theg chen mthong lam nas// sangs rgyas sa yi bar du yod// lnga pa mi mthun phyogs gzhi shes// phung po gang zag bdag gis stong*// stong nyid de la der 'dzin dang*// dus (402)gsum rtogs pa'i 'dus byas chos// de dag bden par 'dzin pa dang*// sbyin sogs byang chub chos rnams la// de dang de ru zhen pa dang*// rgyal ba la sogs 'bras bu la// mngon zhen chags pa phra mos bcings// drug pa gnyen po'i gzhi shes ni// phung po stong nyid 'dus byas chos// sbyin sogs lam dang 'bras bu la// 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa yi// bsam gyis mi khyab rtogs dka' ba'i// spros bral stong nyid mthar thug par// rang nyid gnas shing gzhan dag kyang*// de la sbyor bar byed pa yis// chags pa'i mtha' ni thams cad 'gog

/gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par// rtogs pa'i dngos gnyen yin pas so// ci'i phyir gnyen po'i gzhi shes 'di// rtogs pa'i sgo nas srid zhi la// mi gnas pa ni yin snyam na// dngos po'i rang bzhin can phung por// lnga ni tshu rol so skye yis// bgrod mthong yul gyur 'khor ba'i mtha'// phung lnga rgyun chad myang 'das ni// pha rol myang 'das mtha' yin la// yin lugs chos nyid mtha' gnyis kar// ngo bo nyid kyis mi gnas te// zung 'jug (403)mnyam pa chen po'o// de ni de ltar dngos dngos med// de gnyis bar na phung gsum pa'i// chos ni gang yang min pas te// dngos dang dngos med gnyis ka yang*// chos can nyi tshe ba yin la// de gnyis chos nyid kyi klong du// mnyam pa'i phyir dang de'i chos nyid// mnyam pa chen po de nyid ni// 'khor 'das gang gi mthar mi gnas// de ni gzhi yi sher phyin dang*// bde gshegs snying po chos kyi dbyings// zhes bya des na de nyid la// dmigs pa'i yul can de la ni// lam gyi sher phyin zhes bya ste// de yang mtha' gnyis la mi gnas// zhi bar mi gnas pa'i cha nas// dmigs med snying rje chen po dang*// srid mthar mi gnas pa'i cha nas// shes rab phar phyin zhes bya ste// gang gis de nyid ji lta bar// rtogs nas mtha' gnyis gnas mi srid// de nyid ji bzhin ma rtogs nas// dngos dang dngos med mtshan mar dmigs// de ni sangs rgyas thob byed pa'i// thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang*// dngos dang dngos med (404)mtshan ma ru// mi rtog mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa// thabs kyis nye bar zhes bya ste// de bzhin nyid ni chos kun la// nye ring med kyang tshul bzhin du// rtogs dang ma rtogs dbang gis de// nye ring ltar du gyur pa'o// des na gzhi lam 'bras bu yi// chos la mtshan mar zhen pa ni// spang bya'i gzhi shes zhes bya ba// bzlog pa gnyen po'i gzhi shes te// de yang spang bya spang ba'i ched// blos bskyed lta bu ma yin gyi// chos rnams lam mam gnas lugs ni// rang bzhin gyis ni 'khor 'das dang*// dngos dang dngos med la sogs pa'i// spros pas dben pa yin pa'i phyir// gnas lugs de ni shin tu zab// zab mo mnyam nyid de rtogs nas// 'khor 'das chos rnams dbyer med par// rang bzhin mnyam pa chen por gcig

/shes pas mngon zhen chags pa spong*// srid zhi'i mtha' ni ngang gis 'gog /de lta bu yi chos nyid de// gzugs sogs dngos dang dngos po med// gang gi yang ni shes bya min// yul can mig shes la sogs kyis/ (405)/mthong sogs med par rtogs par dka'// phal pa'i blo yi bsam yul las// 'das pas so so rang rig pa'i// ye shes yul du gyur pa'o// des na dbang dman nyan rang rnams// 'di ma shes pas zhi mthar ltung*// gang gis mthong ba'i byang sems rnams// lam las nyams pa mi srid pa'i// gnad kyi mthar thug 'di yin pas// sher phyin gnad ni gal po che// yin pas thog mtha' bar kun tu// tshul ni de dang mthun par 'chad// shes pa don gyi snying po yin// 'jam mgon a dzi tas gsungs so// bdun pa byang sems sbyor ba ni// zhen pa 'gog tshul sgo nas bcu/ khyad gzhi gzugs sogs zhen pa bkag khyad chos mi rtag sogs zhen 'gog /gzugs sogs bden par bzung bas ni// yon tan rten du ma rdzogs pa'i// kun brtags gzugs dang de bzhin du// bden maid bzung bas yongs grub gzugs// yon tan rten du rab rdzogs dang*// gdags gzhi rnam btags gzugs dang bcas// mtshan nyid gsum la zhen pa bkag /gnyis su snang bzhin pa'i gzugs la// gzugs su zhen pa'i sgo nas ni// gzugs la ci tsam dmigs na yang*// (406)lam gyi yon tan mi bskyed de// so so'i skye bo rnams bzhin no// rang bzhin med pas khyad par du// byas pa'i gzugs la dmigs na ni// sgyu ma bzhin du mthong ba'i phyir// lam gyi yon tan rnams skyed de// 'phags pa rnams kyi rjes thob bzhin// de dag bden zhen chags pa dang*// chags pa med la zhen pa bkag /de bzhin yul gyi sgo nas dbye// sher phyin ngo bo mi 'gyur bas// bstan pas 'phel dang ma bstan pa'i// 'bri ba med par rtogs pa yis// sher phyin spyad byar zhen pa bkag

/sher phyin bstod smad chags sdang sogs// zhi ba'i byed por med pa ste// ngo bo 'dus ma byas yin pas// de ni sus kyang ma bskyed la// don dam par des gang mi skyed// spyod byed por yang zhen pa bkag /bya ba 'bras bu'i sgo nas ni// mkhyen gsum 'thob bya bskyed bya dang*// shes byar don dam du med cing*// tha snyad 'jug bya yin na yang*// de la zhen du mi rung bas// de ni shin tu bya dka'o// 'phags bzhi'i yul la spyod pas na// rigs can gsum gyi skal ba bzhin// 'bras bu thob pas der zhen bkag /sher phyin bslab (407)pas rang stobs kyis// byang chub thob cing srung skyob sogs// gzhan la rag min kun rdzob tu// de ltar yin kyang don dam par// zhen pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*// snang yang rang bzhin med pa'i dpe// rmi lam sgyu ma smig rgyu dang*// sgra brnyan mig yor dri za'i grong*// sprul pa bzhin du snang ba bdun// zhen pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'o// dngos shugs bstan tshul gong dang 'dra// sa mtshams tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'// brgyad pa sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid ni// gzhi shes sbyor ba sgom pa'i tshe// yul dang yul can rang bzhin stong*// mnyam pa nyid du sgom dgos pas// gzugs la sogs pa'i ngo bo dang*// de yi khyad par sngo ser sogs// de yi dbye ba'i spros pa dang*// de yi yul can gyi lam la// rlom pa bkag pa'i 'dzin stangs bzhi// sa mtshams gong dang 'dra ba yin// dgu pa sbyor ba'i 'bras bu ni// theg chen mthong lam bshad pa la// bzod shes brgyad brgyad bcu drug las// sdug bden mi rtag rnam pa ni// gzugs ni rtag min mi rtag min// mtha' bral ngo bo (408)nyid med phyir// sdug bsngal rnam pa mtha' las 'das// stong pa'i rnam pa rnam par dag /bdag med rnam pa skye 'gags med// kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam bzhi las// rgyu yi rnam pa nam mkha' 'dra// kun 'byung rnam pa chags pa spang*// rab skye'i rnam pa yongs 'dzin bral// rkyen gyi rnam pa brjod du med// 'gog bden gyi ni rnam bzhi las// 'gog pa'i rnam pa tshig tu med// zhi ba'i rnam pa dmigs su med// gya nom rnam pa shin tu dag

/nges 'byung rnam pa nad dang bral// lam gyi bden pa'i rnam bzhi las// lam gyi rnam pa ngan song chad// rigs pa 'bras bur rnam mi rtog /sgrub pa mtshan ma dag dang bral// nges 'byin ming don skye ba med// sgro 'dogs so gnyis dang bral ba'i// rnam pa byang sems mthong ba'i lam// skye med mnyam nyid mthong ba ni// chos kun gnas lugs mthong ba'i phyir// des ni sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i// chos nyid ji bzhin gzigs yin gyi// mi rtag la sogs mthong ba ni// mthar thug bden pa mthong ba min// gnas lugs de kho na nyid du// mi rtag la sogs (409)ma grub phyir// mjug sdud mdo dang bstan bcos las// gsungs kyang 'dir ni ma spros so// de ltar rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas sar// lam shes theg chen mthong lam nas// sangs rgyas sa yi bar du yod// gzhi shes theg gsum 'phags pa ni// mtha' dag rgyud la yod pa'o//

skabs gsum pa'o// mkhyen gsum rnam pa kun bsdus nas// sgom pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba las// mtshon byed chos ni bcu gcig las// dang po rnam pa brgya don gsum// de la gzhi shes nyer bdun ni// sdug bsngal rtag pa'i rang bzhin med// skad cig gcig la lhag mi skye// don gzhan bdag gi dben pa dang*// gang zag bdag gi mi brdzi ba// sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi// las nyon gnas su med pa dang*// kun 'byung nam mkha' 'dra ba dang*// rtog dpyod brjod du med pa dang*// sred pa skye ba'i ming med pa// kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi// 'gog pa 'gro ba med pa dang*// gzod nas zhi bas 'phrog tu med// gya nom thar pa zad mi shes// skyed byed rgyu ni med pa ste// (410)'gog bden gyi ni rnam pa bzhi// lam bden rnam pa bco lnga las// nyon sgrib gnyen po mthong ba'i lam// zag pa med pa rnam pa bzhi// bya ba byed po yul shes so// skye dang 'chi 'pho byed pa po// nyon mongs 'dul ba po bzhi la// gang zag bdag med mngon sum du// rtogs pa'i byang sems mthong lam bzhi// lam gyi bden pa rnam bzhi yin// de rnams nyan rang thun mong lam// de steng rang rgyal rjes thob tu// phyi don shes sgrib gzung rtog gi// gnyen po sgom lam zag bcas lnga// rmi lam bzhin du ngo bo med// sgra brnyan bzhin du ma skyes pa// mig yor bzhin du ma 'gags pa// smig rgyu bzhin du spros pa zhi// sgyu ma bzhin du mya ngan 'das// rang sangs rgyas kyi mnyam bzhag tu// phyi don shes sgrib gzung rtog gi// gnyen po mthong lam zag med drug /phyi don dor bya kun nyon med// blang bya rnams kyang dngos por med// bag chags kyis ni gos pa med// gzugs sogs dbye ba'i spros pa med// phyi don zhen par ro myang med// rtogs pa thob zin nyams pa (411)med// theg pa chen por chos thams cad// rang bzhin med pa'i don gyis sgra// ji bzhin par ni gzung dgos so// lam shes rnam pa so drug las// kun 'byung bden pa'i lam shes brgyad// spong gnyen sgo nas bstan pa ni// yul la sred pa'i 'dod chags bral// mi 'bral sred pa'i mngon zhen med// yang srid dga' ba'i sred pa zhi// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug med// tshul bzhin mi byed nyon mongs med// 'jig ltar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa med// lam gyi bden pa'i lam shes bdun// dam bca' 'thad pa'i sgo nas bstan// sems can tshad med thar lam ston// srid zhi'i 'dzin pa bral bas so// chos rnams stong nyid mngon sum rtogs// nyan rang lam la mchog 'dzin med// rnam par mi rtog bden med rtogs// don dam gzhal du med pas so// don dam chags med mngon sum rtogs// sdug bsngal bden pa'i lam shes lnga// mtshan nyid sgo nas bshad pa ste// skad cig 'jig pas mi rtag dang*// 'du byed sdug bsngal khyab pa dang*// byed pa po mod stong pa dang*//

(412) gang zag bdag ni ma grub dang*// ngo bo stong pas mtshan nyid med// 'gog bden lam shes bcu drug po// stong nyid sgo nas bstan pa ni// mig sogs nang gi stong pa nyid// gzugs sogs phyi yi stong pa nyid// dbang rten phyi nang stong pa nyid// bdag med stong nyid stong pa nyid// snod kyi 'jig rten chen po stong*// don dam par ni don dam stong*// 'dus byas 'dus byas stong pa nyid// 'dus ma byas pa de'i stong nyid// rtag chad mtha' las 'das pas stong*// 'khor ba thog tha med pas stong*// lam ni dor ba med pas stong*// byed po med pas rang bzhin stong*// gzugs sogs yul med chos rnams stong*// mtshan nyid med pas de yi stong*// dus su med pas mi dmigs stong*// dngos po dngos med rang dang gzhan// ngo bo nyid bzhi med pas na// dngos po med pa'i ngo bos stong*// de ltar 'gog bden bcu drug la// stong nyid bcu drug bstan pa ni// chos can bcu drug chos nyid kyi// glo bur dri ma bral ba yi// bral cha 'gog bden rnam pa yin// (413)rnam mkhyen gzhi lam rnam pa ni// ma lus yul can yin pa'i phyir// snga ma gnyis kyi rnam pa kun// mkhyen mod 'dir yang lam bden dang*// rjes mthun rnam pa brgya dang bcu// nyan thos rtogs rigs dang mthun pa'i// rnam mkhyen shes rnam so bdun la*// lus tshor sems chos dran nyer bzhi// mi dge mi bskyed skyes pa spong*// dge ba bskyed dang spel ba la// yang dag spong ba bzhi ru grags// 'dun brtson sems dpyod rdzu 'phrul rkang*// dad brtson dran ting shes rab kyi// dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga'o// dran dang chos rab 'byed brtson 'grus// dga' ba shin sbyangs ting nge 'dzin// btang snyoms byang chub yan lag bdun// lta dang rtog pa ngag las mtha'// 'tsho dang rtsol ba dran ting steng*// 'phags pa'i lam gyi yan lag brgyad// byang sems rtogs rigs dang mthun pa'i// rnam mkhyen shes rnam sum cu bzhi// stong nyid mtshan med smon med de// rnam par thar pa'i sgo ni gsum// gzugs can gzugs med gzugs la (414)lta// sdug pa'i rnam thar sprul pa'i lam// gzugs med bzhi dang 'gog pa ste// mthong chos bder gnas lam ni lnga// bsam gzugs brgyad dang 'gog pa ste// mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu// chos bzod bzhi ni spang pa'i lam// sbyin sogs phar phyin drug po dang*// thabs stobs smon lam ye shes kyi// phar phyin bzhi dang bcu la ni// sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam ni bcu// thun mong ma yin rnam mkhyen gyi// shes rnam sum cu rtsa dgu la// gnas dang gnas ma yin pa dang*// las kyi rnam smin mos pa dang*/

khams dang dbang po thams cad du// 'gro ba'i lam dang kun nyon dang*// rnam byang sngon gnas rjes dran dang*// 'chi 'pho skye ba zag pa zad// mkhyen pa'i stobs ni rnam pa bcu// rang don spang ba rtogs pa dang*// gzhan don spang bya gnyen po la// dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs bzhi// chos don nges tshig spobs pa ste// so so yang dag rig pa bzhi// sku la 'khrul pa gsung ca co// dran pa nyams dang mnyam bzhag min// tha dad nyid kyi 'du shes dang*// so (415)sor ma brtags btang snyoms rnams// mi mnga' spyod pa ma 'dres drug /'dun brtson dran pa ting nge 'dzin// shes rab rnam grol nyams mi mnga'// rtogs pa ma 'dres pa ni drug /sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las rnams// ye shes sngon 'gro rjes su 'brang*// phrin las ma 'dres rnam pa gsum// 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta la// ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes// ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum ste// ma 'dres chos ni bco brgyad do// de bzhin nyid dang rang byung gi// sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa ste// thun mong ma yin yon tan gsum// de ltar brgya dang don gsuum pos// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnad bsdus bstan// de dag yid la byed tshul yang*// rjes thob de yi ngo bo rgyu// byed las la sogs ma 'dres par// shes shing sgrub pa'i rnam pa bsgoms// mnyam bzhag mi dmigs rnam pa bsgoms// gnyis pa sbyor ba dngos la yang*// sbyor ba sgom pa'i gang zag ni// sangs rgyas rnams la gtsug lag khang*// bsod snyoms la sogs 'bul ba dang*// dge ba'i bshes kyis zin pa ni// 'di mnyan pa yi snod du rung*// sangs rgyas mang po bsten pa ni// 'di tshig blo la 'dzin pa dang*// the (416)tshom gnas kun 'dri ba ni// 'di don yid la mi brjed dang*// sbyin sogs phar phyin bcu spyod pa// 'di yi sgom byung skye ba'i snod// sbyor ba dngos la nyi shu las// sher phyin sgom pa'i sbyor ba dngos// yul la zhen pa 'gog pa ni// mi gnas pa yi sbyor ba dang*// yul can zhen pa 'gog pa ni// mi sbyor ba yi sbyor ba dang*// gzhi lam rnam gsum ldog pa las// gzhi shes tha mal pa'i blo la// zab pas zab pa'i sbyor ba dang*// lam shes nyan rang la sogs kyis// gting dpag dka' ba'i sbyor ba dang*// rnam mkhyen khyad par 'phags pa'i phyir// tshad med pa yi sbyor ba dang*// lnga ni sbyor ba'i rang bzhin las// 'di dman sa mtshams kyis dbye ba// theg chen tshogs lam dbang rtul gyis// chos nyid sgom byung ma thob pas// tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i sbyor// sbyor lam drod nas stong nyid la// gsal snang thob pas dus nye bar// lung bstan thob pa'i sbyor ba dang*// rtse mor rtogs pa khyad par can// thob pas phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor// bzod pa'i rtogs pas rang don gyi// yid byed gegs las grol bas na// nges par 'byung ba'i sbyor ba dang*// chos mchog mthong (417)lam myur du 'thob// bar chad med pa'i sbyor ba dang*// mthong lam zag med gsar du thob// rdzogs byang nye ba'i sbyor ba dang*// sa bdun chos sku 'grub la phyogs// myur du 'tshang rgya'i sbyor ba dang*// sa brgyad rnam par mi rtog pa'i// ye shes yongs su smin pas na// mnyam rjes kun tu mnyam nyid la// gnas phyir yon tan rnam pa lnga// gdul byar chos 'khor bskor bar nus// gzhan don phun tshogs sbyor ba dang*// skyon yon 'phel 'grib med par rtogs// 'phel 'grib med pa'i sbyor ba dang*// dkar nag chos ni mi dmigs pas// chos dang chos min mi (418)mthong sbyor// gzugs sogs rlom pa med pas na// bsam gyis mi khyab mi mthong sbyor// mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum rnam mi rtog

/dngos por mi rtogs sbyor ba dang*// sa dgur rgyun zhugs sogs bzhi dang*// rang rgyal rdzogs byang 'bras bu drug /gzhan la sbyin par byed pas na// 'bras bu rin chen sbyin pa'i sbyor// gzhan la chos bstan pa sogs kyis// sbyin pa byed tsam dang po nas// yod mod skabs 'dir so so ni// yang dag rig bzhis gdul bya la// rang skal 'tsham par chos bstan pas// rang 'bras thob par mdzad pa'i phyir// sa bcur nyes pa sel ba'i phyir/ (419)/rnam par dag pa'i sbyor ba ste// gnas ngan len gyi sgrib pa phra// 'og ma'i sar dag ma nus rnams// 'dir dag slob lam dag pa la// 'di las lhag pa med pas na// rnam par dag pa zhes bya'o// zhag dang zla ba lo skor sogs// dus tshigs bcad nas sgom pas na// sa mtshams bcas pa'i sbyor ba'i steng*// 'di ni sbyor ba grub pa'i thabs// sa mtshams drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar// gsum pa sbyor ba'i yon tan ni// da lta sher phyin sgom pa la// sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlabs pas// ma 'ongs phan yon bcu bzhi 'byung*// bdud kyi mthu rnams bcom pa dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis dgongs shing mkhyen// sangs rgyas kyis ni mngaun sum mdzad// rdzogs pa'i byang chub ches nyer 'gyur// sangs rgyas mi 'bral don chen 'grub// gdul bya'i yul rnams lung bstan thob// sbyin sogs zag med yon tan rdzogs// sher phyin gzhan la ston pa dang*// bdud kyi ris kyi mi phyed dang*// nyan rang thun min dge rtsa 'thob// dam bcas bzhin du gzhan don 'grub// 'bras bu rnam smin rgya chen 'dzin/ (420)/gzhan don byed pa'i nus pa thob// yum gyi tshig don nges par thob// sa mtshams theg chen tshogs lam nas// sangs rgyas sa yi bar du yod// bzhi pa sbyor ba sgom pa'i skyon// 'gal rkyen gnas dang mthun pa'i rkyen// ma tshang bdud las bzhi bcu drug /yum gyi tshig don yun ring por// rtogs pas skyo zhing zhum pa dang*// thog mtha' ma brtags yum don la// nges pa ha cang myur ba dang*// glal dang dgod la sogs pas yum// 'bri ba lus kyi gnas ngan len// yul la chags pas yum 'bri ba// sems kyi gnas ngan len pa dang*// rnyed bkur 'dod pas kha ton sogs// byed pa lus sems gnas ngan len// 'di las bdag lung ma bstan pas// 'di yi ro ni mi myong zhes// theg chen las ni phyir phyogs dang*// rtsa ba dor nas yal ga tshol// yum dor dman pa'i sde snod 'jug

/rje la slong ba dor nas kyang*// 'bangs la slong ba'i khyi bzhin du// yum don rnyed pa dor ba dang*// glang chen dor nas glang rjes tshol// dman pa'i sde snod tshol ba dang*// (421)rgya mtshor nor bu tshol ba dor// rmig rjes chu las tshol ba ltar// dman las rnam mkhyen tshol ba dang*// nyi zla'i tshad kyi rnam rgyal khang*// tshad sogs bzhin du dman sde'i don// tsam gyis rnam mkhyen 'thob 'dod dang*// drug cu'i zas dang ro brgya pa// 'dra bar 'dzin bzhin theg pa chung*// chen po'i sde snod 'dra ba 'dzin// 'dod pa'i yul la mngon par zhen// yi ger 'bri tsam yum du zhen// dngos po med tsam yum du zhen// yi ger bris zin yum du zhen// yi ge med tsam yum du zhen// yul dang grong sogs yid la byed// rnyed bkur sogs kyi ro myang 'dod// sher phyin dor nas lam ma yin// bdud kyi bstan las thabs mkhas tshol// bdud kyis bstan pa bzhin yin gyi// rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ma yin zhes// chos dang gang zag so sor 'byed// mi sdug sgom sogs yum sgom pa// yin zhes bcos ma nye bar sgrub// sdig can sangs rgyas cha byad du// 'ongs la dad pa skye ba dang*// nyan pa po dang 'chad pa po// gang dang 'brel yang skyon 'gyur ba// gcig shos chos la 'dun (422)pa che// gcig shos snyom las che ba dang*// yul 'dir nyan 'dod yul gzhan du// 'chad 'dod pas ni nyams pa dang*// 'dod pa che chung ma mnyam dang*// sbyangs yon ldan dang mi ldan dang*// dge dang ldan dang mi dge ldan// gtong la dga' dang ser sna can// sbyin 'dod len mi 'dod pa dang*// dbang rnon dbang rtul so so dang*// gsung rab shes dang mi shes dang*// phyin drug ldan dang mi ldan dang*// thabs mkhas thabs ma yin la mkhas// mi brjed gzungs ni thob ma thob// 'bri sogs 'dod dang mi 'dod dang*// 'dun sogs sgrib pa bral ma bral// mthun rkyen rang la ma tshang gnyis// gzhan don ngan 'gror skyer mi 'dod// rang don mtho ris thar par sred// rang gzhan gnyis kar brten pa ni// gcig pur dga' dang 'khor mang dga'// rjes su 'brang ba mi 'dod 'dod// zang zing 'dod dang sbyin mi 'dod// srog la 'tshe ba yod dang med// mu ge'i phyogs 'gro 'dod mi 'dod// chom rkun yod pa'i phyogs su ni// 'gro bar 'dod dang mi 'dod dang*//

(423)bsod snyoms ster ba'i khyim rnams la// yang yang blta 'dod de mi 'dod// 'di dag dpon slob 'dun pa ni// mi mthun chos spyod nyams na skyon// yin gyi ma mthun pa tsam min// bdud las rags pa las dang por// phra ba sa bdun man la yod// lnga pa sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid la// yul ni sngon pos yul can gyi// sngo 'dzin mtshon par byed pa bzhin// mkhyen pa gsum gyi sbyor ba rnams// mtshon par byed pa'i shes mtshon dang*// rtag pa las ni log pas kyang*// mi rtag pa ni mtshon pa bzhin// nyan rang sbyor las khyad 'phags du// mtshon par byed pa'i khyad mtshan dang*// gdung ma 'degs pa'i don byed pas// ka ba nyid du mtshon pa bzhin// gzhan don byed las khyad par can// ldan par byed pa'i byed mtshan dang*// de gsum gyis ni mtshon bya'i gzhi// don ldog ma 'dres mtshan nyid yin// lto ldir ba las bum mtshan bzhin// tha snyad shes brjod kyi yul du// bum sogs bzhag pa'i mtshon bya de// 'jog byed don gyi ldog pa ni// mtshan nyid yongs su grags pa yin// de ni dbyibs dang kha dog sogs// ngo bo yon tan byed (424)las sogs// ci rigs pa las der btags bzhin// 'dir yang mtshan nyid bzhi'i sgo nas// mkhyen gsum mtshon par byed pa ste// tsha reg gis ni me mtshon bzhin// gzhi shes shes mtshan bcu drug ni// 'phags bzhi'i bskyed yum 'di las ni// sangs rgyas 'byung ba shes pa dang*// phung sogs tha snyad ma nor shes// don dam 'jigs pa med pa dang*//

tha snyad du sems can sems kyi spyod pa dang*// nang bsdus tha snyad bdag med mnyam bzhag dang*// phyi rol rnam tha snyad par g.yeng ba dang*// bsdus g.yeng sems kyang de bzhin nyid// ngo bos nam mkha' don dam ltar mi zad// sems de chags sdang tha snyad bcas pa dang*// de nyid chags sdang tha snyad bral ba dang*// chos dbyings don dam ngo bor rgya chen dang*// yul kun tha snyad khyab pas chen po dang*// 'jug yul nges pa med pas na// sems la tshad med gzhal tha snyad ba dang*// dpa' sems ngo bos dbang po la// dbyibs sogs bstan tha snyad du med pa dang*// ngo bo med pas spyan lngas kyang*// don dam sems la don dam bltar med dang*// sems de g.yo dang 'du dang bkram// bcum zhes lung ma bstan lta ba// bcu bzhi phung po la brten nas// 'byung bas gang zag tha snyad bdag med dang*// (425)kun rdzob sems ni g.yo la sogs/ tha snyad de bzhin nyid las ma 'das pa// thub pas tha snyad de bzhin nyid rtogs nas// gzhan la bstan cing tha snyad btags// 'di dag grangs nges med bshad kyang*// bsdu na tha snyad don dam gnyis// dbye na tshad med par 'gyur yang*// gdul bya nye ba'i bsam pa'i ngor// bcu drug 'di dag gdul bya'i don// sgrub la shes pa gal che bas// 'di shes gzhan kun don gyis bsdus// de bas rgyu mtshan med pa min// go tshul 'di 'dra skabs gzhan du// shes par bya zhes mi pham gsungs// lam shes shes mtshan bcu drug ni// chos rnams ngo bo stong pa nyid// rgyu la mtshan ma med pa dang*// 'bras bu smon pa med pa dang*// skye med 'gags med kun byang med// dngos med myang 'das ngo bo nyid// gnas pa'i rten med nam mkha' ltar// sgro skur gyis ni 'khrugs pa med// rgyu rkyen gyis ni 'du mi byed// mtha' ru rnam par mi rtog dang*// rtogs nas mtshan nyid dbye ba ston// don dam mtshan nyid kun dang bral// rnam mkhyen shes mtshan bcu drug ni// 'bras yum sher phyin la brten nas// srid zhi mnyam nyid rtogs pas na// mthong chos bde (426)bar gnas pa dang*// yum la gus dang bla mar bya// mnyes par bya dang de la mchod// don dam gus sogs byed med dang*// ye shes thogs med kun tu 'jug

/mi mthong ba nyid mthong bar bstan// phung sogs 'jig rten stong pa nyid// 'khor la stong pa nyid du brjod// rgyud smin pa la shes pa dang*// rgyud grol ba la mngon sum mdzad// rtog ge'i blo las 'das pa yis// bsam gyis mi khyab nyid du ston// spros pa thams cad zhi ba nyid// 'jig rten don dam ma grub dang*// 'khor 'das blang dor 'du shes 'gog /don gnyis phun tshogs 'bras bu de// rnam mkhyen nyid las 'byung ba ste// de ldan de ltar mkhyen par gyur// de skyed pa yi nus pa ni// rnam mkhyen sbyor ba la yod pas// sbyor ba'i shes mtshan du yang 'gro// 'di ni mi ldan rnam gcod tshul// rnam mkhyen sbyor ba la bsgrubs pas// rnam mkhyen skyed byed du mtshon yang*// de nyid kho nas skyed do zhes// gzhan ldan rnam gcod ma byas pas// lam shes khyad mtshan bshad pas kyang*// 'bras bu rnam mkhyen shugs rtogs dang*// gzhi shes la yang nyan rang gi// de las 'phags par don gyis 'phang*/ (427)khyad par mtshan nyid bcu drug ni// sdug bden chos nyid bsam mi khyab// dpe zla med pas mi mnyam dang*// tshad mas gzhal las 'das pa dang*// grangs kyis bgrang las 'das pa ste// sdug bsngal chos bzod sogs khyad chos// kun 'byung chos nyid rtogs pa des// 'phags pa rnams kyi yon tan sdud// phra zhing mdzangs pa'i mkhas pa yis// ji lta ji snyed rig par bya// nyan rang thun mong ma yin pa'i// yul dus chod pa'i dngos po shes// ji bzhin rtogs la shes gyur bas// mthar thug myang 'das mngon du thob// kun 'byung chos bzod sogs khyad chos// 'gog bden chos nyid rtogs pa des// chos rnams bri dang gang med rtogs// 'khor gsum dag pas sbyin po drug /mos dang yid byed sgrub pa dang*// gus sbyor rtags sbyor tshogs gnyis bsags// yan lag par ni 'grub pa dang*// rnam par mi rtog sbyin sogs brtson// de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa ni// 'gog pa chos bzod sogs khyad par// lhag pa'i bsam pas byang chub dmigs// 'bras bu byang chub chen po nyid// byang sems kho na theg chen rten// smon sogs pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs// lam gyi rnam pa mtha' dag tshang*// phyi yi (428)bshes gnyen nang gi ni// thabs shes yongs 'dzin mtha' gnyis spong*// mchog 'dzin mngon zhen ro myang gi// zhen med dge rtsa rdzogs byang bsngo// lam bden chos bzod sogs khyad chos// byed pa'i mtshan nyid bcu gcig las// gzhi shes sbyor ba'i byed pa gsum// ma 'ongs phan dang tshe 'dir bde// sdug bsngal mtha' dag las skyobs nas// mthar thug mya ngan 'das la 'god// lam shes sbyor ba'i byed pa bdun// lam shes sbyor ba la brten nas// mi sogs myang 'das 'god pa ni// skyabs kyi bya ba byed pa dang*// sdig las bzlog nas dge la bkod// gnas kyi bya ba byed pa dang*// 'khor 'das blang dor med par ston// dpung gnyen bya ba byed pa dang*// sred dang bral ba'i thar par bkri// gling gi bya ba byed pa dang*// skye 'gag med pa sogs bstan nas// gnas skabs mthar thug gzhan don gnyer// yongs su 'dren pa'i bya ba byed// chos rnams nam mkha' 'drar ston nas// rtsol med gzhan don lhun gyis grub// gzhan don theg gsum nges 'byung zhing*// rang don 'bras bu mngon mi byed// chos rnams rnam mkhyen ngang tshul las// (429)'da' ba med par rab ston nas// rten dang lam dang 'bras bur 'god// gdul bya'i rten gyi mdzad pa'o// ngo bo nyid mtshan bcu drug las// gzhi shes ngo bo nyid bzhi ni// chags sogs nyon mongs mngon gyur dben// de'i rtags gnas ngan len gyis dben// de'i rgyu tshul min yid byed dben// spang gnyen blang dor mtshan 'dzin dben// snga ma gsum ni nyon sgrib dang*// phyi ma shes sgrib dben pa'o// lam shes ngo bo nyid lnga ni// don dam ma dmigs kun rdzob tu// sems can tshad med mya ngan las// 'da' bar go bsgos dka' ba sgrub// theg dman mi ltung mtha' gcig tu// 'tshang rgya nges pa nyid la sbyor// bskal pa grangs med bsgrub bya ba'i// ched du bya ba chen po gsum// 'khor gsum mi dmigs rtogs pa dang*// mngon par zhen pa mtha' dag bkag

/rnam mkhyen ngo bo nyid bdun ni// chos kyi khyad par gzhi lam gyi// rnam pa de bzhin nyid la dmigs// 'jig rten kun dang mi mthun par// 'dzin med sgyu ma lta bu dang*// thogs pa med pa'i ye shes 'jug /gzung 'dzin gzhi med rtogs pa dang*// lam 'gro 'ong med dang 'bras bu skye ba med// de (430)bzhin nyid ni mi dmigs pa// de ltar shes mtshan zhe brgyad dang*/ khyad mtshan bcu drug byed mtshan ni// bcu gcig ngo bo nyid bcu drug /mtshan nyid go gcig sa mtshams ni// tshogs lam nas bzung rgyun mtha'i bar// drug pa thar pa cha mthun ni// grangs med gsum du 'tshang rgya ba'i// lam gyi thog ma tshogs lam la// sangs rgyas chos sogs la dmigs nas// yid ches pa yi dad pa dang*// sbyin sogs phyin drug spyod pa la// mngon par spro ba'i brtson 'grus dang*// theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi// dmigs rnam mi brjed dran pa dang*// chos rnams rnam par mi rtog pa'i// zhi gnas rtse gcig ting 'dzin dang*// bden pa gnyis kyi chos rnams kyi// gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyed// bdun pa nges 'byed cha mthun ni// rnam mkhyen skabs su mnyam bzhag dang*// 'dir ni rjes thob gtsor ston pas// drod chung ngur dmigs yul sems can la dmigs nas// chags sdang med pa'i btang snyoms dang*// yid 'ong rnam pa'i byams pa dang*/ drod 'bring du phugs su phan pa'i sems dang ni// kun nas mnar sems khong khro med// (431)lus ngag rnam par 'tshe ba med// drod chen por skyes pa bud med rgan pa la// pha dang ma ru sems pa dang*// mnyam la spun dang sring mo'i sems// gzhon la bu dang bu mo'i sems// yid phebs bshes dang yid brtan grogs// rus gcig gnyen dang mi gcig snag /sbyor lam drod kyi rnam pa bcu/ rtse mo chung ngu bdag nyid sdig pa las ldog gzhan 'god bsngags dang*//

'bring mthun gsum byed pa thams cad la 'gre/ sbyin pa sogs la gnas pa dang*// chen por stong pa nyid ni sgom la gnas// gzhan dag de la bskul ba lus kyis 'god dang*// ma bskul de la gnas pa la// ngag gi bsngags pa brjod pas yid mthun pas dga' skyed gsum// sbyor lam rtse mo'i rnam pa yin// bzod chung rang nyid bden pa bzhi la gnas/ 'bring rgyun zhugs la sogs shes na yang*// mngon du mi bya ba la gnas// theg chen chen por mthong lam la gnas nas// gzhan dag de la 'god pa bsngags mthun gsum byed gsum// sbyor lam bzod pa'i rnam pa yin// chos mchog chung ngur rang gis sems can ma lus pa// theg pa gsum la smin pa dang*// grol dang mthar phyin zhing sbyong dang*// mngaun shes 'bring bskyed pa la gnas dang*// rnam mkhyen chen por skyed dang bag chags kyi// mtshams sbyor spong ba sogs la gnas// gzhan dag (432)de la 'god pa lus gyis 'god ngag gis bsngags yid kyis mthun pa gsum/ gsum// sbyor lam chos mchog rnam pa yin// mkhyen gsum skabs su sbyor mthong lam// bstan pa nyams su blang bya'i yul// sbyor ba dang po gsum gyi skabs// bstan pa nyams su len pa'i tshul// khyad par mi 'dra so so ba// yod pas zlos par mi 'gyur ro// brgyad pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags// zhe bzhi ldan pa'i dge 'dun la// spyir ni dbang rnon tshogs lam nas// lam ma gol bar 'gror yod pas// de nas phyir mi ldog pa yod/ khyad par theg chen sbyor lam gyi// rtse mo bzod pa gang rung thob// phyir mi ldog par nges na yang*// 'dir ni de yi rtags las ni// de nyid nges par nus la bzhag /rang gzhan rtags kyi sgo nas ni// nges ma nus na don la ni// phyir mi ldog kyang de'i 'jog byed// ma rnyed pas de'i ming mi thob// des na dbang rnon drod nas dang*// 'bring po mthong lam dbang po ni// ji ltar rtul kyang sa brgyad nas// rtags thob nges pas de dag bshad// mdo las rnam pa rtags dang ni// mtshan ma de dag dang ldan pa'i// byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog

/gzung bar bya zhes gsungs pa las// (433)rnam pa me yi tsha ba dang*// dmar lam 'bar ba lta bu ste// byang chub sems dpa' de'i rgyud kyi// yon tan khyad can mthong ba'o// rtags ni 'bras bu'i rtags yin te// du ba las ni mer shes ltar// de'i rgyud yon tan khyad par can// yod pa'i 'bras bu bden tshig grub// mtshan ma rgyu las rjes su dpag /ma 'ongs yon tan khyad par can// thob pa'i mtshan mar bzung ba ste// dper na bud shing me lcags rdo// skyes bu'i rtsol ba rnams tshogs na// me 'byung nges par shes pa bzhin// rgyu la gegs byed srid pas na// rgyu tsam gyis ni 'bras bu de// mi dpogs snyam na spyir bden yang*// phyi nang yongs 'dzin gyis zin pa'i// byang sems spyod pa phul byung ni// stobs dang ldan pas gegs gang gis// brdzi bar mi nus rang 'bras 'thob// nus te dpung mang mgron po ni// gang 'dod gnas su bde bar phyin// nges dang 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*// sangs rgyas gzhon nu'i gnas skabs bzhin// des na rgyu tshogs tshang ba las// rang 'bras phyi ma bskyed nges shing*// de la bar chad mi 'jug par// mthar 'bras rgyu (434)tshogs tshang bar byed// des na rgyu mtshan bstan bcos las// lag par 'khor lo'i ri mo gsal// rgyal por 'byung bar lung ston ltar// rgyu yi bye brag khyad par can// de las ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi// mtshan ma gsal bas mtshan mar brjod// de yang lam gyi gnas skabs rtags// gos sogs gtsang ba lta bu ni// de dag byang chub sems dpa' yi// nang gi bsam pa khyad par can// rang don zhi ba don gnyer blo// mngon gyur log pa'i snying rje dang*// sbyor ba thabs shes khyad par can// rtogs pa brtan po dang 'brel ba// yin pa'i rtags su nges par 'gyur// de la rtags ni mang yod kyang*// mdor bsdus sbyor lam nyi shu dang*// mthong lam bcu drug sgom lam du// zab mo brgyad ldan rtogs rnams las// sbyor lam drod kyi dbang rnon des// don dam stong nyid rtogs pa las// rjes thob 'dzin pa

gzugs sogs la bden zhen mngon gyur spang*// skyabs mchog gsum la the tshom mngon gyur med pa bram ze sogs skyabs mi bsten/ dang*// mi khom brgyad du mi skye dang*// smon lam 'grub pas mi dal brgyad zad pa/ bdag gzhan dge la gnas brtson pa dang 'god// dge 'bras sems can kho nar chos sogs gzhan don sbyin la 'jug pa bsngo*// zab mo'i don la som chos la gcig tu dga' ba nyi med// byams pa'i lus ngag ngag tu tshig 'jam po smra ba sogs las dang ldan// 'dod 'dun (435)gnod sems gnyid rmugs dang*// rgod 'gyod the tshom sgrib pa lnga// mi 'grogs ma rig lta ngan sogs// bag la nyal kun nyams smad 'joms pa dang*// 'gro 'chag nyal dang 'dug par dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa dang*// gos sogs gtsang dang bcu gcig ni// drod kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags// lus la srin bu brgyad khri mi 'byung dang*// sems la gya gyu med rang don yid byed sems med dang*// sbyangs yon rnyed pa mi 'dod par bcu gnyis la len pa gnas dang*// ser sna 'chal tshul sogs med dang*// ci byed thams cad rnal 'byor chos nyid ldan par 'gro ba ldan// gzhan don dmyal bar sdug bsngal tshaul 'gro ba dang// drug ni rtse mo'i lam rtags yin// lam log gzhan dring mi 'jog pas gzhan gyis bkrir mi btub// me lnga brten pa sogs lam log ston la bdud ces rtogs// sher phyin bzod pa'i lam rtags rnam gnyis yin// 'khor gsum dag pas bya ba kun// sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa ni// chos mchog phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags// de ltar nyi shu sbyor lam rtags// mthong lam rtags ni bcu drug las// mthong lam ye shes rang nyid min// gzhan la rtags su snang mi rung*// rgyu ni mnyam bzhag ye shes las// 'bras bu rjes thob 'byung ba'i rtags// de la ye shes bcu drug ming*// btags (436)pa rgyu ming 'bras bur btags// dgos pa gdul bya 'dul ba'i dbang*// ma gtogs byang sems rjes thob ni// mnyam bzhag 'dra bar shes slad yin// mnyam bzhag chos nyid mngon sum du// mthong ba'i stobs las rjes thob tu// chos su zhen pa'i
gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa kun btags spong*// byang chub sems ni rab tu brtan// theg dman sems ni rnam par log /bsam gzugs sgo

yan lag yongs su zad pa yang der mi skye// sdug bsngal chos bzod sogs kyi rtags// lus sems las rung yang ba nyid dang shin sbyangs thob// 'dod yon spyod kyang zhen pa med/ thabs mkhas/ rtag tu tshangs par spyod la gnas// log 'tsho mo 'gugs 'tsho ba rnam par dag sogs mi byed// kun 'byung chos bzod sogs kyi rtags// phung khams sogs la dang por zhen// sbyor ba'i gnas pa rgyun du zhen// rjes su sbyor ba'i gnas pa ni// so sor bkag par bya ba dang*// de bzhin bar chad byed pa'i chos// dge ba'i nor 'phrog rkun po bzhin// rgyu tshogs sbyin sogs dmag 'dra'i mang nyung du zhen pa gtam// grong dang grong khyer grong rdal bcas// sgras bstan dbang po dbang rten dang*// dbang yul skyes bu rnam shes la// yul dang yul can zhen pa dang*// zhen med spang gnyen g.yul 'gyed la// sbyor dang rjes sbyor bkag pa bzhi// (437)'gog pa chos bzod sogs kyi rtags// 'di skabs gtam zhes smos pa ni// ming la zhen pa'i gnyen po ston// don la zhen pa sdug kun kyi// shes pa'i skabs su bcom zin phyir// zhes bshad mngon zhen med pa'i gnad// dngos bstan grangs sogs mtshon don ni// dbang sogs mngon 'dod zhig pas de// gtam du smra dang lus kyis 'jug /mi byed pa yang don gyis brtan// snyam ste gtam ni zhe 'dod gyi// rjes su byed pas nang gi ni// rnam pa mtshon pa'i rtags yin phyir// 'jam mgon mi pham pa yis gsungs// ser sna 'chal tshul khong khro la sogs pa'i// gtam la sbyor dang rjes sbyor gzhan la gnod pa mi byed/ bkag /lam dang 'bras bu'i chos gang la// rang bzhin grub par rdul tsam mi dmigs dang*// gzhi lam rnam gsum skye med rang gi sa la nges thob med pa nyid du// rtogs pas mkhyen gsum sa gsum la ni gnas pa la gnas// rnam mkhyen 'thob byed chos kyi

don du phyir// srog btang ba la sdug bsngal med// de bzhin lam bden bzod sogs rtags// sgom pa'i lam gyi khyad par ni// stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med// smon med mngon par 'du mi byed// skye med 'gags med chags bral dang*// 'gog zhi mi gnas de (438)bzhin nyid// yang dag mtha' ste bcu gcig gi// gnas lugs zab mo rtogs pa ste// sgro skur mtha' dang bral ba'i phyir/ khyad gzhi sgom pa'i lam la ni// sbyor mthong sgom pas sngar mthong ba'i// mkhyen gsum rnam pa stong nyid la dmigs nas// ltos pa'i rigs pa la sogs pa// rigs pa bzhis ni yang yang sems// 'jog pa'i sems sogs zhi gnas kyi// sems dgus yang yang 'jal ba dang*// 'byed dang rab 'byed yongs su rtog /yongs su dpyod pa'i lhag mthong bzhis// yang yang nges par rtogs pa'o// gzugs la sogs pa'i rang bzhin ni// dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gting ngam gnas// mi rnyed pas ni zab pa ste// stong pa yin la de yi phyir// de la dmigs pa'i blo bskyed pa'i// mtshan ma med cing des na der// brten pa'i yul can skye ba ni// rab zhi rnam thar gsum ldan gyi// rang bzhin du ni gnas pa de// sgro skur bral ba'i de kho na// nyid yin de rjes son pa yi// sgom lam ye shes zab pa nyid// sbyor lam skabs nas de nyid la// sgro 'dogs bcad de yang yang sems// mthong (439)lam de nyid mngon sum mjal// sgom lam rtogs zin yang yang goms// sngar las je bas je zab tu// song bas nges par rtogs pa yin// de nyid zab ste mthong zin pa// gom pa'i lam ni yin pas so// sgom lam skad cig ma ma yin// rgyun chags yin pas spang bya dgu'i// gnyen po rim bzhin skye ba yin// sgom lam dgu po re re yang*// 'bras bu bsod nams grangs med dang*// tshad med gzhal med mdo las gsungs// des na de yi sgom lam yang*// dgu ru nges pa med snyam na// 'bras bu grangs med sogs bstan pa// bden par grub pa'i rgyu gcig las// 'bras bu grangs med 'byung ngo zhes// mang nyung grangs kyis dbye ba min// don dam rgyu 'bras mang nyung med// rgyu 'bras bden par grub pa na// tshad yod rgyu las tshad med kyi// 'bras bu mi 'byung de mi 'dod// tha snyad sgom lam re re yang*// 'bras bu mtha' yas 'byung ba ni// don la de ltar yin gzigs nas// thub pas bstan gyi dgongs can min// de yang rgyu gcig las 'bras bu// du ma skye ba tsam du ni// sa bon (440)gcig las 'bru du ma// yang yang 'phel ba sogs kyis grub// mtha' yas sems can la dmigs nas// sangs rgyas 'thob rgyur bsngo ba dang*// de yang mngon par ma zhen pa'i// thabs la mkhas pas yongs su zin// bden gnyis ro mnyam chos kyi dbyings// ngo bor gyur pa'i tshul 'jug pa'i// sgom pa skad cig bsaud nams kyang*// tshad bzung med par rigs pas grub// dngos smras stong pa nyid yin na// spang thob mi srid do zhe na/

khyod kyi sngar yod zad pas stong*// ngo bo nyid kyis stong yang rung*// stong par don du gcig pas na// theg chen don la ma skrag cig /don la 'phel dang 'grib med kyang*// tha snyad tsam du rten 'brel dbang*// sems ni skad cig skye 'gag can// cig char mi 'byung rim can 'byung*// sems bskyed skad cig dang pos kyang*// byang chub mi 'thob phyi ma rnams// re rer nus pa mi srid pas// rnam mkhyen 'thob mi srid ce na// mar me skad cig skye 'gag ni// byed kyang du ma rgyun mthun pas// snum zad sdong bu bsregs nus ltar// snga phyi'i sems ni tshogs med kyang*// snga ma snga ma (441)la brten nas// phyi ma phyi ma nus pa 'phel// rtogs bya de bzhin nyid la yang*// gsal ba rab kyi mthar thug pa'i// ye shes 'byung zhing de 'byung bas// spang bya spong bar 'thad pa yin// sgom lam phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags// zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad// tha snyad rten 'brel mi bslu'i dbang*// don dam mi skye gnyis mi 'gal// go yul tsam du ma yin par// gzhi gcig steng na phun tshogs spong// mi dgos mnyam par rtogs pa yi// zung 'jug rtogs pa khyad par can// skye ba la ni zab pa dang*// de bzhin dngos rnams byung tsam nas// rang grub pa yi dus skad cig /gnyis par mi sdod 'gag pa dang*// don dam rang bzhin med pa yi// mi 'gag pa gnyis 'gal med rtogs// 'gag pa la ni zab pa ste// de gnyis gzhi yi rtogs tshul yin// slob pa'i lam du shes rab kyis// de bzhin nyid la goms na yang*// snying rjes dus min mngon mi byed// de bzhin nyid la zab pa ste// 'di ni de bzhin nyid dbyings su// sems dang sems byung mtha' dag 'gog /yang (442)dag mtha' la goms pas na// ro mnyam gyur nas ldang dka' ba'i// tshul du mnyam par 'jog nus pa// sa brgyad pa nas thob na yang*// da rung shes bya'i sgrib bcas phyir// sangs rgyas lta bu ma yin te// mnyam par bzhag bzhin shes bya kun// gzigs pa'i ye shes ma thob pas// de dag skyed 'don yod pa'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pas 'gog pa las// slang nas rdzogs smin sbyangs mthar phyin// stobs las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin/

khyad par can bskyed shes bya'i sgrib// phra mo sbyangs te sangs rgyas su// 'gyur bar mdzad kyis mnyam bzhag de'i// ngang la gnas pa mi mdzad pa'i// cha nas de ltar gsungs pa'o// chos rnams spros pa dang bral bas// sbyin sogs sgrub tu med na yang*// kun rdzob sbyin sogs sgrub pa'i tshul// ma nor bar ni shes bya dang*// de gnyis 'gal med rtogs pa ni// shes bya la ni zab pa dang*// chos rnams rang bzhin ma grub pas// dmigs pas mthong bya rdul tsam med// ma mthong ba nyid mthong ba'i mchog /dmigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i// ye shes mthong ba rang gsal ba// shes pa la ni zab pa dang*// (443)chos la spyod pa med pa'i phyir// mi spyod pa ni spyod pa'i mchog /thugs chud rtogs pa khyad par can// spyod pa la ni zab pa dang*// lam la grub pa mi 'dor bas// 'bras bu mngon du byed na yang*// don la bsgrub bya sgrub byed med// ye nas mnyam pa'i chos nyid la// gnas pa gnyis med la zab pa// de lnga spyod pa nyams len tshul// yin te gzhi yi dbang byas te// de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la/ khyad par med par yod na yang*// rdzogs smin sbyangs pa mthar phyin nas// sgrib gnyis ma bral dus min du// mngon du mi byed par shes dang*// lam la yul ni shes bya dang*// yul can la ni shes pa dang*// nyams len spyod pa rnam gsum dang*// 'bras bu gnyis su med pa ste// sgrub byed bsgrub bya gnyis med par// gzigs pa'i cha nas zab pa'o// kun rdzob tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs// de yi 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob// mi rloms thabs mkhas zab pa ste// don la 'thob bya ma dmigs dang*// rang byung ye shes 'dus ma byas// rgyu yis sgrub par mi nus phyir// de ltar zab mo brgyad po ni// stong dang rten 'byung 'gal 'dzin blor// phan tshun gcig gis gcig (444)bsal bas// zung 'jug ro mnyam rtogs par dka'// mi 'gal mnyam pa'i tshul rtogs pa'i// zab mo brgyad ldan ye shes ni// sa brgyad pas thob rjes mthun pa'i// lus ngag tha snyad rang gzhan ngor// yid ches nges par yod pa ni// phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags yin no// dgu pa srid zhi mnyam nyid sbyor// sa brgyad gnas pa'i byang sems des// chos rnams rmi lam 'dra bar mthong*// gnyid bslad

srid pa lta bu'i 'khor ba dang*// gnyid sad lta bu'i zhi ba myang 'das gnyis// rang bzhin med pa mnyam nyid rtogs// bcu pa zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba// rang nyid gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i// sangs rgyas zhing ni dag pa nyid snod dang bcud kyi zhing dag pa/ khyad par can ni 'grub pa'i rgyu// dge rtsa nus pa mthu can myur// des ni snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa mthong nas de la/ gser gyi sa gzhi la// baiḍūrya yi mig mang ris// rin chen shing sogs mdzes pa'i snod/ sems can 'jig rten bcud rnams lha yi nyer spyod ldan// mi dge bcu dang ngan song gi// ming tsam med par dag pa sgrub pa yin// bcu gcig thabs mkhas sbyor ba la/ bar chad las brgal ba bdud bzhi nyan rang sa dgra rnams las 'das pa'i thabs mkhas sbyor ba so las 'das// mnyam nyid sgom pa mi gnas gnas pa'i sbyor ba dang*// gzhan don smon lam thams cad ji bzhin shugs kyis 'phangs pa ltar 'grub// gzhan don dka' spyod goms pas nyan rang thun mong (445)ma yin mtshan nyid can dang*// chos la goms zhing bden 'dzin dag pas chags pa med pa dang*/ rnal 'byor sgo gsum goms pas chos dang gang zag mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid// rgyu la mtshan ma med pa dang*// 'bras bu smon pa smon lam zad pa med pa dang*// 'dri ba'i lan la thogs pa med// phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags/ rig gnas lnga sogs tshad med rtogs// thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba bcu// sangs rgyas 'thob byed mnyam nyid sbyor// snod bcud dag byed zhing dag sbyor// gzhan don thabs mkhas sbyor ba gsum// sa mtshams dag pa gsum na'o// /skabs bzhi pa'o// de nyid goms pa'i rtse sbyor la// mtshon byed chos brgyad yod pa las// dang po drod kyi rtse sbyor ni// sad dus lam la goms pa las// rmi lam na yang chos thams cad// rmi lam lta bur shes pa dang*/ lta ba/ nyan rang sa dang khams gsum la// dga' ba'i sems ni mi skye dang*// sangs rgyas chos ston mthong ba dang*// rdzu 'phrul ston pa mthong bar rmi/
