'jigs skrag sogs kyi rmi lam rmi lam du shes nas// sad nas rmi lam 'dra ba'i chos ston pa'i sems skye dang*// sad rmi gang rung du dmyal sogs sems can mthong ba na// ming tsam med par smon pa dang*// sad rmi gang rung du grong khyer me yis tshig pa na// zhi byed bden tshig grub pa dang*// sad rmi gang rung du skye (446)bo gnod sbyin gyis zin pa// zhi byed bden tshig grub pa dang*// rang gi bdud las yin 'di man sad dus rtags yin min shes pa yis// sdig grogs zil gyis gnon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*// mnyam rjes kun tu sems can rnams// smin phyir sher phyin slob pa dang*// kun byang chos rnams stong nyid du// shes la mngon zhen med pa dang*// byang sems skyon med la zhugs pas// sangs rgyas byang chub nyer gyur pa// drod rtse'i rtags ni bcu nyis so// gnyis pa rtse mo'i rtse sbyor la// bsod nams rnam 'phel bcu drug ni// 'dzam gling skye bo'i grangs mnyam pa'i// sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dge ba las// 'di yi bsod nams rnam par 'phel// de bas kyang ni gus dang rtag /sbyor bas sher phyin yid byed mchog / sbyin gnas mchog dam par gyur/ /de bzhin mi skye ba yi chos// stong nyid mi skrag bzod pa thob// 'gro ba yongs su grol/ byang chub rgyu 'bras chos thams cad// mi dmigs par ni rtogs pa cher brtson pas 'dzin dang*// 'dzam gling sems can thams cad kyis// dge bcu bsam gzugs thob pa las// lhag pa'i rtse mo'i sher phyin thob// de yi stobs kyi lha'i ris rnams// drung du 'ongs nas srung bar byed// byang chub la bskul/ de yis bdud rnams zil gyis gnon// byang sems gzhan la ston pa (447)ltar// gus shing de dang bslab pa mtshungs// 'di dag dpe dang gang zag gzhan la ltos pas phyi gtso bor gyur pa'i rnam 'phel/ tshogs gnyis kyi

thabs la mkhas gzugs med nyan rang yid byed bral pas bslab pa dag /sangs rgyas gser 'byung ba'i sa nyung ba'i dpe rigs nges can du 'gyur// sangs rgyas rgyu yi yon tan 'khor bsgyur nyung ba'i dpes sems bskyed sogs nus pa 'phel thob// ser sna la sogs sems mi skye// bden 'dzin kun brtags 'dzin pa mngon gyur spang*// rtse mo'i sher phyin nang du ni// phar phyin kun bsdus nyams su len// tshul shes/ sgom byung gi stobs kyis theg chen rtogs rigs phun tshogs thob// de yi mthus rdzogs byang nye bar gyur pa'o// 'dir rtags dang rnam 'phel sogs dang por thob pa'i sa mtshams 'dzin pa yin gyi gong mar med pa min la zhing dag sbyor sogs cha 'dra snga ma nas yod kyang yongs su dag pa khyad par can dag sa nas thob pas der bzhag pa sogs 'di 'dra gong 'og kun tu sbyar te shes par bya'o// gsum pa nang gtso bor gyur pa brgyad bzod pa'i rtse sbyor la// rang don rtogs mkhyen gsum chos rnams yongs su rdzogs pa bstan pa dang*// gzhan don sems can don yongs su mi gtong ba/ snying rje bstan pa gnyis// bzhi pa chos mchog rtse sbyor ni// gling bzhi pa dang stong dang po// stong gnyis stong gsum 'jig rten rdul// grangs las byang sems sems dang po bskyed pa mos spyod dang*// ma dag spyod pa la zhugs pa sa bdun dag pa phyir mi ldog gsum// sa bcu gnas skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang sems

pa'i dge ba la// yi rang bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ rtsa bar/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dag dang*// stong gnyis gsum dag dper mdzad nas// bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni// ting 'dzin yongs su grags pa yin// zhes gsungs so/ /de las rang 'bras mthong lam skyed// ting 'dzin (448)mtha' yas pa la sems// kun tu gnas pa'i chos 'dis gzhan la yi rang ba dang*/ 'di la gzhan gyis yi rang ba'ang bshad/ mchog gi /bsod nams 'di ni tshad med do// lnga pa mthong lam rtse sbyor la// spang bya rtog pa gzung 'dzin gnyis// zhen yul log pa'i 'khrul shes yin// 'di dag don la ma grub pa'i phyir de dag la bden grub tu bzung nas de dag tu sems pa'i rtog pa ni mnyam rjes gnyis kar spang bya yin la bden par ma zhen pa'i rjes thob gnyis su snang ba can ngos nas spang mi dgos kyang der 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma'i rtog pa dag kyang mnyam bzhag gnyis med kyi ye shes la mi snang bas na yang dag pa'i don du de ltar gzung ba'i yul tsam du'ang ma grub par shes par bya ba gal che/ de la 'jug pa gzung rtog dgu// don dam par mi thob kyang tha snyad thob pa'i ngo bo ni theg chen lam dang 'bras bu la// dmigs nas 'jug byar zhen pa dang*// mi g.yo ba sogs sa gsum la// sangs rgyas rigs su dmigs pa dang*// chos rnams sgyu ma ltar rtogs pas// mthong ba'i lam sogs yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan ltar rtogs nas// theg chen shes pa'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul dang*// skyon yon mthong ba sngon 'gro bas// mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po spang bya 'phel 'grib med pa dang*// sgrib byed dri ma dang bral bas// rang gi rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen nyid la dmigs pa dang*// rigs nges theg chen la 'god pas// nyan rang thag bsring byed la dmigs// gdul bya'i bsam pa mthun sprul nas// (449) sems can don byed theg chen de'i byed las

la dmigs dang*// thabs shes ldan pas sems can rnams// las su bya ba'i 'bras bu myang 'das 'god pa la dmigs nas// 'jug byar 'dzin pa'i zhen pa'o// ldog pa gzung rtog la yang dgu// srid zhir ltung ba'i phyir rtogs pa dman pa'i theg dman gyi// lam la ldog byar 'dzin pa dang*// thabs shes ldan pa'i yongs su 'dzin pa med// gzhan don sgrub pa'i lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang*// srid pa tha mar slob dpon la// ltos pas thar pa gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro ba gzhan la rag /rang don zhi bde la zhugs pas// gzhan don chen po ched du bya ba log pa gsum las nyams// nyon sgrib tsam gyi gnyen po ni// sgom pas lam ni nyi tshe ba// gzugs sogs dmigs pas 'bras bu ni// rtogs pa mtho dman sna tshogs nyid// ma rig bag nyal ma spang bas// theg chen lam la gnas dang 'jug ma rmongs dang*// theg dman rang 'bras thob pa'i rjes// theg pa che la 'gro dgos pa// rnams la ldog byar zhen pa'o// so so'i skye bo'i rten can gyi// don la grub par rdzas 'dzin dgu// yon tan 'dzin dang skyon 'dor ba'i// gang zag rdzas yod la dmigs nas// longs su spyod por zhen pa dang*// chos rnams bden par yid byed dang*// des ni khams gsum dag dang 'brel// de la (450)gnas pa'i gang zag dang*// rang bzhin med par mngon par shes pa dang*// btags tsam chos kyi dngos po btags pa khong du chud pa dang*// phyin drug chags pas nan tan spyod pa dang*// srid zhi blang dor 'dzin pa yi// gnyen po bden med sgom pa dang*// sher phyin yang dag ma shes pas// ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gro ba la nyams nas rnam mkhyen yun ring thob pa yi// gang zag rdzas yod 'dzin pa la// dmigs nas longs spyod por zhen pa// 'phags pa'i rten gyi blos btags pa'i// btags 'dzin rtog par dgu yod de// nyan rang byang chub nges 'byung bas// med bzhin nges par mi 'byung ba/

chen po gsum ni mi sgrub pa'i// skyes bu btags par 'dzin la dmigs// longs spyod por ni zhen pa dang*// nyan rang nyer zhi'i lam med pas// theg chen lam la lam min nges par 'dzin pa dang*// rgyu 'gag sa dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu skye ba la// don dam nyid du zhen pa dang*// bar chad yod med khyad par gyis// lam rnams dngos po rgyun mi chad pa ru// ldan dang mi ldan 'dzin pa dang*// nam mkhar gnas pa'i bya bzhin du// gzugs sogs mi gnas gnas pa dang*// sems bskyed phyin drug sogs slob pas// theg dman rigs ni 'jigs shing nyams par byed// stong nyid rtogs tsam chog shes nas// 'bras bu sangs rgyas don gnyer med// dus gsum sangs rgyas spang rtogs rgyu// sher phyin (451)sgom pa med pa dang*// ser sna la sogs goms pa yi// byang chen phyir rgol ba ni bar gcod bdud bzhi dang*// nyan rang sa gnyis la dmigs pa'i// skyes bu btags par 'dzin pa la// dmigs nas longs spyod por zhen pa// de dag rnams ni kun btags phyogs// mthong rtse'i rgyu la gsum yod de// theg chen rigs can byang chub la// 'god pa'i don du 'bras bu ni// rtogs pa'i chos gzhan la ston pa dang de yi rgyu// lung gi chos ni gzhan la yongs su gtod ston// de thob bar chad med pa'i rgyu mnyam bzhag shes phyin rang gis sgom// snga ma gnyis ni bsod nams tshogs// phyi ma gcig ni ye shes tshogs// mthong rtse'i 'bras bu byang chub ni// sgrib gnyis dri ma ma grub pas// zad pa med dang mi skye ba// mngon sum mthong ba'i ye shes yin// 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// chos rnams gshis lugs dri ma med// yin pas blo des de mthong gi// gal te yul de dri bcas zhig /dri ma med par mthong mi rung*// mthong na dri med mthong ba'i blo// phyin ci log gi log shes 'gyur// rgyud ldan gang zag dag mi 'gyur// dri ma can du mthong ba'i blo//

(452)gnas tshul zhugs blo yin pas so// dngos smras sngar yod dri ma zad// phyis mi skye ba zad mi skye// 'dod kyang bden par yod pa de// nam yang 'gog pa mi srid pas// rigs pa dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur// chos rnams don dam yod par 'dod// ston pas shes sgrib spang 'dod pa'i/ khas blang nang 'gal smra de la// rje btsun byams pas mdzad ces gsungs// chos rnams don dam du grub tshe// 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis// shes sgrib ci ltar 'dzad par bya// theg pa chen po'i rang lugs la// dngos po'i gshis la sgrib pa gnyis// sngar yod bsal ba ci yang med// stong pa la sogs yon tan cha// sngar med bzhag pa cung zad med// dngos po'i rang bzhin byar med la// bsal bzhag bcos su mi gtub pas// des na mnyam pa chen po'i don// de dang rjes mthun dgag sgrub kyi// bslad bral blos ni yang dag blta// mnyam par bzhag pa goms pa'i mthus// gnas lugs mtha' bral de kho na'i// don mthong rang rgyud mtshan rtog las// grol bar 'gyur zhes 'doms par mdzad// de ltar chos nyid bsal bzhag med// de las phyin ci log gyur pa'i// rtog pa (453)rnams ni ldog pa la// spang bya spong ba'i tha snyad dang*// chos nyid rjes su mthun pa'i blo// skyes la rtogs bya rtogs zhes par// snang tshul tsam du brjod pa ste// don la bsal bzhag gzhi ma grub// mthong rtse rang gi ngo bo ni// go sgrub skabs su bshad pa ltar// sbyin pa la sogs phyin drug re re de dag phan tshun drug drug bsdus// 'khor gsum mi dmigs rnam pa can// skad cig gcig gi sdug bsngal chos bzod sogs bsdus pa// de ni mthong ba'i lam bar chad med lam de/ rtse sbyor yin// sbyin sogs ma lus pa'i rang bzhin// stong nyid gzigs pa'i ye shes te// snang stong mnyam nyid don de la// gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis ni// mnyam par bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir// de yi

ngang nas seng ge rnam bsgyings ting nge 'dzin byed las rnam grol lam la snyoms par zhugs nas de las lang ba'i rjes thob tu// rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung ldog / ma rig pa'i rkyen gyi 'du byed sogs kun nyon lugs mthun kun 'byung*/ ma rig 'gag pas 'du byed 'gag sogs rnam byang lugs mthun lam bden/ rga shi skye ba las byung sogs kun nyon lugs ldog mi mthun sdug bden/ skye ba 'gag pas rga shi 'gag sogs rnam byang lugs mi mthun 'gog bden/ sgom nas bden bzhir nges pa skyed// drug pa sgom lam rtse sbyor la// gnyen po sgom lam ting 'dzin la// rtsal sbyong ched (454)du thod rgal sgom// de yang mthar gnas snyoms 'jug dgur// yar song lugs mthun gcig dang ni// mar 'ong lugs mi mthun gnyis la// sbyor ba seng ge rnams bsgyings dang*// dngos gzhi bsam gtan dang po nas// 'gog pa'i bar gyi dgu po la// bar du gang yang ma spel ba'i// yar song gcig dang bsam gzugs ni// brgyad la 'gog pa spel ba yi// yar song gcig dang mthar gnas kyi// snyoms 'jug dgu la 'dod sems ni// spel ba'i mar 'ong gcig ste lngar// sher mdo las gsungs ma pham pas// sbyor bas seng ge rnam bsgyings gnyis// 'dod sems spel ba'i mar 'ong bcas// dngos su bstan nas bar pa gnyis// go slar dgongs nas ma gsungs so// spang bya rtog par gzung 'dzin gnyis// 'jug pa gzung rtog lhan skyes dgu// dbang rnon don du gsungs pa'i chos// mdor bsdus brjod byar bcas pa la// 'jug byar zhen pa'i 'dzin pa dang*/ dus de gsum yon tan don yar med pa 'jug byar zhen pa gsum// de gsum myang 'das bgrod byed legs pa'i lam// rnam gsum la 'jug byar zhen pa'i 'dzin pa dbang brtul don du gsungs pa'i chos// rgyas pa brjod byar bcas pa dang*// mdo rgyas sgrub par mi byed pa'i/

/sangs rgyas kyis yongs gsungs pa'i// gnyen po sher phyin yid la byed// mthong lam la ltos sbyor lam 'das// sgom lam ma 'ongs da lta rang*/ (455) gsum// 'di rnams sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi// sbyor ba nyer bsdogs kyis spang bya// ldog pa gzung rtog la yang dgu// nyan thos tshogs lam la gnas par// theg chen yongs 'dzin bral bas na// dgra bcom thob par byang chub sems// mi skye ba nyid byang sems kyi// lam gyi ldog byar zhen pa dang*// de bzhin nyan thos tshogs lam pas// gzhan don dmigs pa'i bsod nams tshogs// med pas chos sku yid byed byang chub snying por med// nyan thos sbyor lam la gnas pas// theg dman rang 'bras yid la byed// rang rgyal sbyor lam la gnas pas// rang gi 'bras bu yid la byed// nyan thos mthong lam la gnas pas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid byed med// nyan thos sgom lam la gnas pas// dmigs bcas sher phyin gzugs brnyan sgom// nyan thos dgra bcom sar gnas pas// gnas lugs de nyid sgom pa med// de dag la ni ldog pa nyid// de nyid sgom du med pa dang*// mi rtag sgom pa med par min// gnas lugs don la phyin ci log /de nyid ji bzhin don min la zhen// de rnams byang sems lam gyi ni// ldog byar zhen pa'i lhan skyes rnams// bar chad med pas (456)spang bya yin// rdzas 'dzin rtog pa lhan skyes dgu// phung por sems can btags pa'i spyod yul pa la// so skye sogs kyi rdzas yod du// 'dzin la spyod byed zhen pa dang*// gzugs sogs chos su btags pa'i dang*// tha snyad tsam du yod pas na/ stong nyid min/ rnam mkhyen sogs la btags pa dang*// gzugs sogs chags pa'i so skye dang*/// chos rab rnam 'byed bdag gi byang sems dang*// dngos por zhen pa byed pa nyan thos dang*// gzhan don theg gsum lam zhugs byang sems dang*// yon ni mi dag nyan thos dang*// phar phyin mi spyod

spyod pa rnam par 'khrugs pa/ nyan thos sogs// gang zag rdzas yod 'dzin pa la// dmigs nas longs su spyod byed du// bden par zhen pa'i 'dzin pa'o// btags 'dzin rtog pa lhan skyes dgu// bdag nyid ji bzhin chos rnams stong nyid ma rtogs pas/ kun mkhyen ni mkhyen gsum sgrib pa rnam pa gsum spong ba la// rmongs la skyes bu btags par 'dzin// de la longs su spyod byed du// bden par 'dzin pa'i 'dzin pa gsum// thabs mkhas bral bas sgrib pa kun// zhi ba'i lam la rmongs pa dang*// chos can chos nyid ma shes pas// de bzhin nyid sogs dang mtshungs par ldan dang mi ldan pa'i ngo bo tha dad la rmongs dang*// ngo bo stong nyid ma shes pas// theg pa che chung (457)lam mi mnyam pa la rmongs// mi rtag sogs ston nges don bzung*// sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden bzhi'i chos nyid la rmongs dang*// glo bur ba dang stong nyid du// ma shes nyon mongs rnam kyi rang bzhin rmongs// gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan stong ma shes// de nyid gnyis su med la kun tu rmongs// de dag skyes bur btags 'dzin la// spyod byed nyid du zhen pa'o// spang bya spangs ba'i phan yon ni// 'gal rkyen yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni// yun ring lon nas dbugs 'byin ltar/ nad rim byang ba bzhin// mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa ni/// rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba yi// bde sgrub yon tan phun tshogs kun// rgya mtsho che la chu bo bzhin// 'bras bu mchog gi spang ba yis// sems dpa' chen po de la ni// rnam pa kun tu bsten par byed/ bdun pa bar chad med rtse ni// stong gsum skye bo ma lus pa// nyan thos dang rang byang sems sa skyon med dang po// bkod pa'i bse ru'i rtogs pa phun tshogs dang*// dge ba dge ba dper mdzad nas/ bsod nams de bas kyang*// 'di nyid sgom pa khyad 'phags te// 'dis ni bsod nams thun mong nyid kyis

bsam mi khyab// sangs rgyas nyid kyi bar med de la sbyor ba'i phyir// bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen ye shes so// sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la// 'di yi dmigs pa kun med de// bdag po dran pa yin par bzhed/ dmigs nas 'di yi rnam pa ni// spros pa'i mtshan ma zhi ba nyid ste// stong nyid mngon sum rtogs pa'i blo// sa mtshams rgyun mtha' kho nar yod// brgyad pa bsal bya log sgrub ni// sun 'byin ltar snang bcu drug (458)yod// chos rnams rang bzhin 'thad med pas na// dmigs pa rnam de yi ngo bo ngos bzung ba pa 'bras rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes bu dang*// dam pa'i don dang kun rdzob bden pa gnyis dang spyod pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum po dang thabs mkhas dang*// bcas/ thub pa'i rtogs pa mngon par rtogs dang phyin ci log gi spang bya dang*// lam gyi ngo bo bcas spang gnyen po mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen dang*// mtshan nyid dang ni sgom pa la// dngos por smra bas mi 'thad ces// rgol yang rang mtshang ston byed nyid// de la sher phyin la gnas pas// phar phyin gzhan kun 'jug pa ni// mi 'thad ma yin shin tu 'thad// bsam gtan tshad med ro myang maid// brtson 'grus tshad bzung med pa dang*// bzod pa dpag par dka' ba dang*// tshul khrims shin tu skyon med dang*// sbyin pa mur thug med pa ste// phar phyin re re'i yon tan kyang*// phyogs dus mu mnyam tshad dpag dka'// skyon gyi dri ma yongs dag pa// gang dang mtshungs pa maid pa ste// sher phyin mthu las rig par bya// 'di ltar gang zag bdag 'dzin gyis// mi mthun phyogs rnams 'byung ba dang*// chags bral gtong sogs 'jug mi nus// dngos dang dngos med dmigs (459)pa na// blang dor zhen pas zhi mthar ltung*// dmigs bcas tshogs kyang dag mi 'gyur// ma rig bslad can yin pa'i phyir// des na phar phyin gzhan dag la// sher phyin med na mi 'byung la// mtha' bral sher phyin yod pa na// rgyud ldan byang chub sems dpa' de// ser sna la sogs med pas na// lus dang longs spyod dge rtsa la*// kun 'dzin chags pa phra mo yang*// med pa'i sbyin pa sogs la 'jug

/lan dang rnam smin re ba med// 'khor gsum dri ma med par 'gyur// 'di ltar sher phyin mthong ba des// zhi mthar nam yang mi ltung zhing*// sems can phan bde sgrub par byed// lam gyi dus na rdzogs smin sbyangs// mthar phyin byed la skyo zhen med// 'bras bu lhag med myang 'das dus// mi gnas ye shes sku thob nas// nam mkha' ji srid sems can don// rtag khyab lhun grub mdzad pa yang*// sher phyin 'di yi stobs kyis yin// gal te stong nyid mngon mthong bas// sbyin sogs 'gog pa zhig yin na// de ni (460)sher phyin ma yin te// dngos med tsam yin ma dmigs par// btags kyang dngos por ma dmigs kyang*// dngos med du ni dmigs pa'i phyir// dmigs med sher phyin gtan nas min// sher phyin don ni thos bsam gyis// sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i dus na yang*// srid zhi'i mtha' la mngon par zhen// nyams smad byed pa zhig yin na// dngos su rtogs la smros ci dgos// sbyin pa gtong sogs sher phyin gyis// zin na phar phyin drug ldan 'gyur// mi mthun phyogs ni sher phyin gyis// bcom pas sbyin pa gcig pu yang*// tshul khrims la sogs ngo bor 'gyur// spros bral rtogs pa'i ye shes la// ldog chas phye na gnas mi gnas// mtshan ma zad pa bsam gtan che// brtson dang mi brtson zhi brtson 'grus// zhes sogs snang cha sbyin sogs dang*// stong cha shes rab ngo bo ste// zung 'jug rnam kun mchog ldan gyi// stong nyid phar phyin kun sdud yin// de 'dra'i gnad la mkhas pa ni// sher phyin nyams len mdo 'gag yin//

skabs lnga pa'o// dbang du bya ba'i rgyu (461)'bras bu// thob nas brtan par gyur phyir du// mthar gyis pa yi sbyor ba dgos// de la mtshon byed chos bcu gsum// 'khor gsum dag pas rab phye ba'i// sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab kyi// rnam pa thams cad rdzogs pas ni// sa bcu yang dag 'grub byed pas// de dag lam gyi mthar gyis pa// dran pa nye bar bzhag la sogs// don dam spros pa kun dang bral// tha snyad mtshan nyid ji lta ba// dran pa rgyu yi sgo nas ni// sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang*// de bzhin dge dang mi dge ba// lung ma bstan rnams blang dor dang*// btang snyoms bya ba chos rjes dran// byang 'phags dge 'dun rjes dran dang*// tshul khrims gtong ba'i phan yon dran// lhar skyes 'phags pa dran pa ste/ khyad par byed pa'i mthar gyis pa// chos med dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid med spros dang bral// rtogs pas zin pa sgom pa de// lam ni dag byed mthar gyis pa// zin byed de dag gis zin pas// mkhyen gsum rnam pa ma lus pa// go rim nges can dkyus (462)gcig tu// sgom pa mthar gyis sgom tshul yin// tshogs lam mthar gyis bya ba dang*// sbyor lam mthar gyis slob pa dang*// mthong sgom mthar gyis sgrub pa'o// de la mkhyen gsum gyis rnam pa// brgya dang don gsum gyis don du// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam pa kun// bsdus pa yin yang de rnams ni// dkyus thog gcig tu blo la shar// tsam ni mthar gyis thun min min// 'on kyang ring ba'i sbyor ba tsam// gzhi lam rnam gsum skye med du// sgom pas don gyis bsdus na yang*// de tsam zhig gis der mi 'gro// 'o na ci lta bu yin na// gnyis 'dzin can gyis chos gcig bsgom// de las gzhan du 'jug mi shes// de nyid bsal bar bya ba'i phyir// sbyin pa lta bu re res kyang*// phar phyin gzhan rnams kun bsdus na// thabs shes 'brel ba'i nyams len la// zag med chos kun 'du ba dang*// phar phyin kun sdud yin pa'i tshul// log sgrub bsal skabs bshad (463)pa bzhin// rjes thob go rim nges can nam// so sor dmigs phyed pa'i tshul gyis// nyams len sbyin pa sna gcig la'ang*// phar phyin gzhan kun tshang tshul gyis// mngon zhen med par bsgrub bya zhing*// mnyam bzhag chos rnams ro gcig pa'i// de kho na nyid goms pa'i mthus// nyams len gcig gi steng du yang*// mkhyen gsum rnam pa brgya don gsum// gyis mtshon nyams len mtha' dag kun// rim gyis 'dren zhing 'char thub pa'i// gnad ni khyad par can la ni// myong dang nges pa je cher 'phel// song la mthar gyis zhes bya ste// chos gcig steng du gzhi lam 'bras// rtogs bya ji snyed pa rnams la// sgro 'dogs gcod par shes pa yi// shes rab khyad 'phags kyis zin pa'i// sgom tshul khyad par can zhig yin// de yang sgom bya'i lam rnams kyi// ngo bo rer yang pha rol phyin// drug ldan gyur pas lam mtha' dag

/dkyus thog de la tshang ba dang*// bsgom pa'i rten ni dkon mchog gsum// bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gsum// gong nas gong du khyad par du// 'phel ba mi mnyam par byed cing*// (464)dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid// des ni chos rnams tha dad du// med par rtogs pas gnyis 'dzin spong*// nyams len sna gcig nyid la yang*// gzhi la sgro 'dogs chod pa dang*// lam ni yongs su dag pa dang*// 'bras bu dpe byad rdzogs kyi bar// bsdus la dmigs rnam je gsal du// song nas mtha' med 'phel ba ste// don la shes rab pha rol phyin// mnyam pa nyid kyi mthu kho nas// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid la// nyams len byed nus tshul yin la// de yang blo gcig gi steng nas// gsal ba rab kyi mthar thug bar// sgom par nus na grub pa'i tshad// de ni skad cig sbyor ba yin// de nyid rim gyis 'dren pa ni// mthar gyis pa yi skabs yin no// des na phar phyin gcig la yang*// phar phyin gzhan kun 'dren thub pas// mtshon nas gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi// dmigs rnam mtha' dag dkyus gcig gi// rim gyis 'dren thub nyams len la// mthar gyis sbyor ba zhes bya yi// grangs kyi nges pa 'di tsam zhig /'char thub dgos zhes mi bsam ste// dang po phyin drug rnam pa tsam// (465)de goms rnam pa brgya don gsum// de nas rnam pa tshad med pa'i// chos kyi sgo ni ma lus pa'i// dmigs rnam mtha' yas 'char ba'i bar// 'phel te skad cig sbyor ba'i skabs// zag med chos kun mngon byed gsungs// de yang chos gcig de bzhin nyid// chos kun de bzhin nyid yin la// mnyam pa chen po de nyid kyis// kun byang chos kun bsdus pa'i phyir// dmigs pa'i yul can gyi dri ma// dag rim mtshungs par chos gcig gis// chos kun mngon du byed nus pa// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid kyis// stobs las yin par shes par bya// 'jam mgon a dzi tas gsungs so//

skabs drug pa'o// /de goms skad cig sbyor ba la// mtshon byed chos ni ngo bo gcig /ldog pas phye bas bzhi yod de// rnam smin ma yin skad cig sbyor// byang sems rgyun mtha' rang rgyud la// rnam par smin zin ma yin pa'i// zag med chos gcig mngon byas nas// sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang*// zag med chos kun bsdus pa'i phyir// thub pa'i skad cig gcig pa yi// rtogs pa 'di ni shes par bya// ji ltar skyes bus zo chun rgyud// rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na// thams cad gcig char 'gul ba ltar// skad cig gcig gis de bzhin byed// (466)rigs mthun zag med chos mtha' dag /'bad dang rtsol bar mi ltos par// bya rdzogs skad cig thung mtha' la// mngon du byed par nus pa ste// sngon gyi smon lam 'phen pa dang*// de bzhin nyid ni ro gcig mthus// gnyis pa rnam smin skad cig sbyor// chos gcig mngon byas chos thams cad// gang tshe chos dkar thams cad kyi// rang bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin// rnam smin chos nyid gnas skabs skyes// de tshe skad cig gcig ye shes// rtsol med mngon du bya nus te// yun ring bdag med rtogs pa la// goms pas sgrib gnyis bral bas so// gsum pa mtshan nyid med pa'i sbyor// sbyin pa la sogs spyod pa ni// chos kun rmi lam 'dra gnas nas dang 'dra bas// kun byang bsdus pa'i chos rnams kyi// ngo bo mtshan nyid med pa nyid ni// skad cig ma ni gcig gis rtogs nus te// sa dgu man chad tshogs gnyis lam// rmi lam lta bur goms pas so// bzhi pa gnyis med skad cig sbyor// (467)rmi lam rang gi de mthong nyid skabs su yul yul can// gnyis kyi tshul du mi mthong ltar bzhin// chos rnams gnyis su med pa'i de bzhin nyid// skad cig gcig gis mthong nus te// sa dgu man la gnyis snang gi// bag chags spong la goms pas so// snga ma gnyis ni yon tan chos// mngon du byed tshul phyi ma gnyis// yul gyi rtogs tshul sgo nas bzhag

/de la bzhed pa 'ga' zhig na// rnam smin min ni sngar rgyud la// smin zin min pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// yon tan stobs la sogs pa dang*// rnam smin yin pa rang rgyud la// smin zin sbyin nas dpe byad bar// gnyis ka yul du byed par bshad// yang na rnam smin min pa ni// sa bdun man chad sgom pa dang*// rnam smin dag pa'i ye shes dang*// so 'phags sogs bshad yod na yang*// 'dir ni de gnyis yul can gyi// bar chad med pa'i skad cig ma'i// rang gi ldog cha nas bshad de// de la rnam smin min pa ni// slob lam sbyin sogs re re'i nang*// zag maid chos kun ngo bos (468)ni// 'du tshul shes nas der bsdus te// yongs rdzogs goms pa'i'abad rtsol gyis// goms pa mthar thug pa'i dbang gis// da lta dngos po so sor 'dzin// phyin ci log dang bral ba'i phyir// sbyin sogs re res sbyin pa nas// dpe byad bar gyi zag maid chos// bsdus de'i ngo bo mthong ba'i phyir// thub pa'i bar chad med lam gyi// skad cig gcig gi rtogs pa 'di// rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i// skad cig ma ru shes bya ste// sngar gyi rnam par smin min pa// bar chad med lam snga rol du// byung ba'i mthar gyis sbyor ba las// byung ba shes par bya ba'i ched// rgyu ming 'bras bur btags pa'am// yang na rnam par smin pa yi// rgyu las byung ba'i skad cig ces// sa bon gyi ni 'bras bu bzhin// dper na zo chun 'khyud mo de// rgyu yi dus na thag pa sogs// re re bzhin du 'dus byas kyang*// bzo nyid legs par tshar rjes su// rdog thabs gcig gis bskyed pa na// thams cad gcig char du 'gul zhing*// chu len pa sogs byed (469)bzhin du// sngon du 'bad rtsol goms pa'i mthus// da lta 'bad med mngon du gyur// skad cig rang gi ngo bo ni// rnam par smin pa nyid yin te// de yang dngos gcig rang bzhin ni// dngos kun rang bzhin yin pas na// chos nyid tha dad med pa dang*// yul can blos kyang de bzhin du// sgom zhing 'bad rtsol gyis bsgrub nas// skad cig mngon du byed gyur cig

/snyam pa'i 'phen dang tshogs rdzogs pas// gnas lugs zab mo mthong nus pa'i// mthun rkyen tshang zhing 'gal rkyen bral// rgyun mtha'i rdor ting skad cig 'dir// rim can min par cig char snang*// de phyir rnam par smin pa ni// rgyun mtha'i bar chad med thob pa// ngo bos dri ma med pa yi// zag med chos dkar thams cad kyi// rang bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin// rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid// rtsol med thob pa'i rnam smin nam// yongs su rdzogs pa skyes pa'i tshe// de la rnam smin skad cig brjod// de yang gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi /bag chags (470)bslad pa'i ring la ni// chos kun mnyam pa chen po'i don// ji lta ba bzhin gzigs mi nus// gnyis snang can ngor chos can dang*// dus dang chos nyid tha dad pa'i// gnyis chos snang bas shes bya kun// bden gnyis gcig char gzigs mi srid// gnyis snang bag chags drung 'byin pa// rgyun mtha'i ye shes skyes pa'i tshe// mnyam pa nyid don mthar thug pa// gzigs pas de yi bsdus kun kyang*// de dang ro mnyam par gzigs shing*// de las g.yo ba mi srid pas// bden gnyis gcig char gzigs pa yin// chos nyid gshis la skye 'gags sogs// spros pa'i mtshan ma med na yang*// gnyis snang bslad pa'i gdul bya'i ngor// skad cig re re bzhin du yang*// gdul bya'i rgyud dang skye 'gag chos// de dag mkhyen nas don mdzad pa'i// cha nas rnam mkhyen skad cig ma// lta bur snang las mi shes pas// rnam mkhyen mi rtag pa zhes gzhag /byis dang mu stegs rtsod pa'i ngor// de ltar 'chad par bya dgos so// rang gi ngo bo (471)chos nyid dang*// gnyis med rang byung ye shes sku// skye 'gag med don gyis gzhal na// dus gsum kun tu 'pho 'gyur med// rnam mkhyen ye shes rtag pa zhes// mdo dang sngags las gsungs pa bzhin// rang gi zab don khong chud pa'i// rjes kyi nges pa de ltar gnas// dngos dang dngos med 'dus byas yin// mya ngan 'das pa 'dus ma byas// brten nas skyes pa'i 'dus byas ni// dngos po'i chos rnams yin pa dang*// brten nas btags pas 'dus byas su// song ba dngos maid gnyis ka yang*// 'dus byas yin te dngos med rnams// dgag bya bcad la bden grub la// de la ma ltos mi grub pas// gzhan la ltos pas res 'ga' 'am// 'dus byas lta bu yin pas so// dngos dang dngos med gang gi mthar// mi gnas myang 'das chen po ni// chos nyid bsal bzhag med pa dang*// ro gcig bsam brjod las 'das pas// rgyu las skye'am btags mi dgos// chos nyid ye nas gnas pas so// myang 'das rgyu las skye ba ltar// snang 'di rang gi gnyis snang gi// rtog pa log tsam las der btags// don la chos rnams rang (472)bzhin gyis// mya ngan las 'das srid dang zhi// mnyam pa nyid kyi don la ni// glo bur sgrib pa bsal stobs kyis// dri ma mtha' dag log pa yi// zung 'jug chen po de nyid la// sangs rgyas ye shes skur brjod do// de ltar zag maid chos kun kyi// ngo bo chos nyid kyis bsdus ltar// mnyam pa'i chos nyid mngon byed lam// rnam smin min pa ma bskyed na// de 'bras rnam smin mi 'byung la// de skyed mi nus snyam na ni// chos rnams mtshan nyid tha dad du// bden par grub pa zhig yin na// chos gcig mngon du byas pas kyang*// chos kun mngon du byar mi nus// de ltar ma yin chos thams cad// mtshan nyid med pa'i dbyings su gcig

/des na mtshan nyid de bzhin nyid// dri ma bral bar mthong ba la// de bzhin nyid las gzhan pa yi// snang ba zhes bya gang yang med// de ni snang stong zung 'jug gi// de bzhin nyid ces bya ba ste// kun mkhyen chen po klong chen pas// kun rdzob rnam par chad pa'i phyir// rnam par dbye ba'i yul 'das pas// btags pa'i bden gnyis las 'das phyir// de nyid spros kun zhi ba nyid// bden pa dbyer med grub pa dang*// (473)ma grub pa med chos dbyings la// snang stong rang bzhin dbyer med pas// bden pa de la dbyer med ces// brjod do zhes ni gsungs pa bzhin// de yang mnyam pa chen po yi// dbyings su tshul gcig pa de ni// so so rang gis rig bya ba// yin gyi gnyis snang can gyi ngor// snang ba lta bu ma yin no// de ltar chos nyid gnyis med pa// mnyam pa chen po de'i don la// gnyis 'dzin bag chags ma lus pa// drung nas phyung ba'i ye shes ni// yul dang yul can gnyis med pa'i// ro mnyam chen por gyur pa yin// de bas rnam pa thams cad kyi// mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid kyi// rang bzhin rdul dang skad cig ma'i// cha bsags pa las 'das pa yi// mkha' khyab ye shes chen po'i sku// 'bras yum shes rab pha rol phyin// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen zhes bya// de skad gzhan dring mi 'jog par// rnam dpyod rang stobs kho na yis// legs gsungs bka' dang dgongs 'grel don// ji bzhin smra la thogs med pa// 'jam mgon mi pham pa yis gsungs// rnam rdzogs sbyor ba theg chen gyi// tshogs lam nas bzung rgyun mtha'i (474)bar// rtse sbyor theg chen sbyor lam gyi// drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar du yod// mthar gyis sbyor ba tshogs lam nas// rgyun mtha'i snga logs bar dang ni// skad cig sbyor ba rgyun mtha' rang*// skabs bdun pa'o// de yi skad cig gnyis pa la// 'bras bu mthar thug chos sku thob// de la mtshon byed chos bzhi las// dang po

thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni// /dag pa gnyis ldan chos nyid sku// zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag thob gyur yon tan ldan pa dang*// glo bur dri ma bral ba dang*// rnam kun rnam dag pa/ gnas lugs de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can mthar thug rtogs pa'o// snang cha rtogs pa ye shes kyi// rang bzhin stobs sogs zag med chos// stong pa dbyings kyi cha de ni// ye nas 'bral med zung 'jug gi// chos nyid mngon du gyur pa ni// ngo bo nyid kyi sku zhes te// ye shes sku ni mthar thug yin// 'di ni stong rkyang tsam min te// gzhi dus na yang stong rkyang tsam// chos nyid mthar thug ma yin la// 'bras dus na yang de'i cha tsam// sangs rgyas min te med dgag tsam// de la mkhyen sogs sangs rgyas kyi// yon tan rdul tsam med par ni// sngon gyi mkhas pas gsungs pa ltar// don la gnas shing sangs rgyas kyi// rtogs pa dang ni 'brel ba'i phyir// des kyang mkhyen par mi rung ste// 'on te sems dang ldan pa'i phyir// (475)shes na mi shes 'jig par thal// zhi ba lhas ni gsungs pa bzhin// des na sangs rgyas sku bzhi pos// rnam pa thams cad mi mkhyen med// yod na sangs rgyas min par 'gyur// gnyis pa de yi mkhyen cha la// brtags pa'i ye shes chos sku ni// zag med chos sde nyi shu gcig /byang chub phyogs

mthun chos so bdun dang*// byams sogs tshad med rnam bzhi dang*// gzugs can gzugs la lta sogs gsum// gzugs med bzhi dang 'gog pa ste// rnam par thar pa brgyad dang ni// mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu// yi bdag nyid/ zad par sa chu me rlung ste// 'byung ba la ni brten pa bzhi// sngo ser dmar dang dkar po ste// 'byung 'gyur la ni brten pa bzhi// nam mkha' dang ni rnam shes te// zad par skye mched bcu yi bdag nyid dang ni// rang la gzugs dang gzugs med par// 'du shes sgo nas phyi rol gyi// gzugs ni che chung la blta zhing*// zil gyis gnon nas zhi gnas kyis// shes shing lhag mthong gis mthong ba'i// dbyibs ni zil gyis gnon pa bzhi// rang la gzugs med 'du shes nas// phyi rol kha dog bzhi po la// blta zhing zil gnon shes mthong ba'i// kha dog zil gyis gnon bzhi ste// zil (476)gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni rab tu dbye bas rnam pa brgyad// pha rol nyon mongs drung 'byin pa'i// nyon mongs med pa'i ting 'dzin dang*// shes byar chags thogs med pa yi// smon gnas mkhyen pa'i ting 'dzin dang*// rdzu 'phrul la sogs mngon shes drug /so so yang dag rig pa bzhi// lus dang longs spyod ting nge 'dzin// ye shes yongs su dag pa ste// rnam pa thams cad yongs su dag pa rnam pa bzhi dang*// tshe dang sems dang yo byad dang*// las dang skye ba mos pa dang*// smon lam rdzu 'phrul ye shes dang*// chos la dbang ba'i dbang bcu dang*// stobs bcu mi 'jigs rnam pa ni bzhi dag dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa ni// yongs su dag pas kun spyod ngan// gzhan gyis shes dogs bsrung dgos pa// med pas bsrung ba med pa rnam gsum// dang*/ chos ston pa dang 'ga' zhig gis// gus pas nyan la dgyes pa dang*// de las ldog la mi dgyes med// 'dres ma dag la btang snyoms te// dran pa nyer bzhag rnam pa gsum// gzhan don mdzad pa'i dus las ni// nam yang mi 'da' bsnyel ba'am// brjed pa mi mnga'i chos

nyid dang ldan// sgrib pa gnyis kyi bag la nyal// zad par spangs pas sgo gsum gyi// bag chags yang dag bcom pa dang*// nyin mtshan dus (477)drug skye ba sems can la// phan bde sgrub pa'i dgongs pa ni// thugs rje chen po nyid dang ldan// thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos ni bco brgyad dang*// gzhi lam rnam pas bsdus pa'i shes bya'i rnam pa ma lus pa// thams cad mngon sum mkhyen pa rnam mkhyen nyid// dang*/ chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ de la nyon mongs med pa yi// ting nge 'dzin ni nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta// mi yi nyon mongs yongs spongs nyid/ sogs/ bsod snyoms sogs su rgyu ba na// nyon mongs skye dang mi skye ba// brtags nas 'gro dang mi 'gro tsam// de bzhin gshegs pas sems can gang*// bdag la dmigs nas nyon mongs pa// rgyun du gnas par ma gyur ces// de la dmigs nas de ru gshegs// de yi nyon mongs grong sogs su de'i nyon mongs rnams// rgyun gcod rgyal ba'i nyon mongs med/ rgyun gcod mdzad// sangs rgyas smon gnas mkhyen pa yang*// ni 'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis grub// mngon par zhen pa'i chags pa spangs*// sgrib gnyis spangs pas thog pa med// mnyam par bzhag bzhin rtag tu gnas/ 'dri ba kun la dus gcig tu// lan 'debs mdzad par bzhed pa'i khyad chos lnga// nyan rang sogs ni de las ldog /gang shes 'dod na 'di nyid ni// shes par gyur cig snyam du smon// ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs// de las ldang nas de shes pa// de ni smon gnas shes pa yin// byang phyogs (478)la sogs ming mthun yang*// ye shes ldog cha nas bstan pas// slob pa rnams dang thun min nyid// sangs rgyas rnams la rnam rtog med// rtag tu mnyam par bzhag yin na// gzhan don gtan nas mi mdzad dam// yang na gcig char 'byung ba las// res 'ga' rig pa min zhe na// sangs rgyas sku dngos su snang nas// gdul bya gzhan don mdzad pa na//

rgyu ni yongs su smin gyur nas// gang dang gang la gang dang ni// gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa// de dang de la de snang ngo*// gdul bya'i bsod nams la rag las// rgyu rkyen 'dzoms na snang ba dang*// rgyu rkyen ma tshang mi snang ngo*// lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*// sa bon mi rung mi 'khrung ltar bzhin// sangs rgyas rnam ni byung gyur kyang*// skal ba med par bzang mi myong*// zag med ye shes chos sku ni// sangs 'phags so so'i rgyud la yod// shes bya kun la khyab mi rigs// de nyid skad cig re re bzhin// skye 'jig byed pas rtag pa zhes// brjod pa rigs pa min zhe na// de ltar mdzad pa rgya che'i phyir// sangs rgyas khyab par nges par brjod// phrin las 'jug pa rgya che zhing*// shes bya thams cad dus gcig tu// gzigs pa'i phyir na khyab par brjod// ye shes rgyun de nyid zad pa med pa'i phyir// rtag pa zhes kyang brjod pa yin/ / mi chad pas na// rtag par brjod la 'gal ba med// (479)sangs rgyas de yang phyogs dus kyi// gdul byar gang 'dul sku dang gsung*// rnam pa thams cad lhun grub 'char// nam mkhas gar khyab sems can la// mdzad pas khyab pas khyab pa dang*// phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar// zad pa med phyir rtag pa yin// de skad 'jam dbyangs mi pham gsungs// gsum pa nges pa lnga ldan gyi// gzugs sku mthar thug mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ / longs dpe byad sku yi// theg chen= khyad par thub pa'i= mtshan bzang so gnyis ni// slob pa'i dus na bla ma la// skyel bsu mchod rten la sogs pa dang mchod pas// phyag dang zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa dang*// sdom pa yang dag blangs ba la dam bca' brtan// pa dang*/ rus sbal lto ba'i phyogs bzhin du// zhabs kyi mthil gnyis ma skongs par// sa la mnyam par gnas pa dang*// bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi brten dang spyad pas// phyag dang zhabs sor mo dra bas 'brel// sor gdub sogs kyang gzhug tu rung*//

ba dang*/ bza' bca' gya nom pa byin pas// phyag gi zhabs ba cas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags// ldog pa gya nom pa dngos po byin pas// 'di pa'i phyag zhabs rgyab bzhi phrag gong gnyis// ltag pa dang bcas sku yi gnas bdun dag mtho// ba dang*/ /gsad bya bcings sogs thar bar byas pas// sor (480)mo tshad ldan ring ba dang*// srog bsrung 'tsho ba'i thabs 'bad pas// zhabs kyi rting pa yangs pa dang*// srog gcod spangs pa mi phal pa'i/ khru bdun 'phags pas sku che zhing*// ya yo med par drang ba dang*// dge chos yang dag par blangs pas// zhabs kyi pus mo'i lha nga dang*// long bu che ba 'bur ba phyir mi mngon// dge ba gzhan la spel bas na// ba spu re bzhin gyen du phyogs// bzo sogs rig pa gzhan byin pas// byin pa e na ya 'dra bar// zlum zhing rgyas la rim par 'tshams// slong ba po rnams ma spangs pas// sku ma btud kyang pus mo yi// lha ngar sleb pas phyag ring mdzes// tshangs spyod len du bcug pa dang*// gsang tshig bsrungs pas rta mchog ltar// 'doms gyi sba ba sbubs su nub// pa'i mchog gding ba gya nom pa byin pas// pags pa gser mdog dag gsal dwangs// gzhal yas khang bzang sogs byin pas// pags pa srab la shin tu 'jam dang*// 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng sogs spangs pas// sku yi ba spu re re bzhin// g.yas su legs par 'khyil zhing 'khrungs// gong mar rim gro cher byas pas// mdzod spu dkar 'jam mnyen (481)pa ni// drangs na khru gsum btang ba na// g.yas 'khyil rtse mo gyen du phyogs// skyu ru ra ni 'bru tshad tsam// gzhan tshig khyad du ma gsod pas// ro stod 'phel ka che ba ni// seng ge'i stod dang 'dra ba dang*// gzhan gyi legs smra'i rjes mthun pas// 'di pa'i dpung pa'i mgo gser bum mgrin pa bzhin// zlum la rtsa ni phyir mi mngon// sman dang sman pa sogs byin pas// dpung mgo phan tshun bar thal gong*//

brang mi mnyam med pas shin tu rgyas// nad par rim gro g.yog byas pas// 'di la ro mi zhim pa'i zas ngan yang*// ro bro'i mchog tu snang ba dang*// kun dga' ra ba sogs byin pas/ sku ni shing n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng mnyam// gtsug lag khang sogs byin pa las// zlum zhing gnag la kun nas mnyam// g.yas su 'khyil pa'i gtsug tor dbur ldan// tshig 'jam snyan par gsungs pa las// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khebs pa dang*// bzhad na stong gsum khebs pa yi// utpal dmar po'i mdog (482)'dra ba'i// ljags ni ring zhing mdzes pa dang*// gsung gcig gis ni sems can la// skal ba 'tshams pa'i chos ston pas// shes shing rnam par shes pa dang*// mnyan par 'os shing mi mthun med// zab cing dbyangs snyan shin tu 'byung*// btang mi bra zhing rnar snyan pa// 'khrugs pa med cing gsal ba ste// yan lag lnga ldan tshangs pa'i dbyangs// ngag 'khyal spangs shing dus su smras// 'gram pa me long dkyil 'khor ltar// zlum rgyas lta sdug seng ge'i 'dra// ba dang*/ skye bo kun la bkur ba yis// tshems ni kunda bzhin du dkar// log 'tsho spangs pas tshems mtho dman// med cing ring thung tshad mnyam dang*// bden tshig smras pas tshems la ni// bar mtshams ma dod thag bzang dang*// phra ma spangs pas tshems kyi grangs// ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang*// sems can bu gcig 'drar bltas pas// spyan ni dkar nag ma 'dres shing*// nor bu mthon mthing 'dra ba dang*// gzhan la khro chags rmongs med pa// spyan gyi steng 'og rdzi ma rnams// legs par gzhol zhing ma 'dres pa// ba mchog gi rdzi ma 'dra ba ste// 'di dag skyes bu chen por mtshon byed sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// (483)de rgyu grangs med gsum goms pas// 'di la mtshan ni gang gang gis// 'grub par byed pa'i rgyu gang yin// de dang de ni rab rdzogs pas// mtshan ni 'di dag yang dag 'grub//

'bras bu mtshan bzang de rnams 'grub// nang gi yon tan gzhan rnams la// go 'byed dpe byad brgyad bcu ni// 'dod chags bral ba mthar phyin pas/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs kyi mdog 'dra dang*// lhag bsam rdzogs pas mdog ni snum// rgyal rigs skyes la sangs rgyas mthong*// spyod tshul kha na ma tho med// sor mo rnams ni zlum pa dang*// dge rtsa rdzogs pas sor mo rgyas// pa dang*/ theg gsum rtogs rigs mtha' dag rdzogs// rtsa ba nas bzung byin gyis phradad ba dang*/ mi dge bcu dang log 'tsho spangs// lus kyi rtsa rnams phyir mi mngon// nyon mongs mdud pa grol bas na// rtsa la mdud pa med pa dang*// zab mo rtogs pa'i blo mnga' bas// long bu chung ba phyir mi mngon// srid las sems can sgrol bas na// zhabs ni ring thung med par mnyam// mi sogs zil gnon seng ge'i stabs// klu sogs zil gnon glang chen stabs// mkhar gshegs bya ngang pa'i rgyal po'i stabs// dang ni/ tshogs kyi sna 'dren khyu mchog stabs// gshegs/ g.yas phyogs (484)skor bas g.yas gshegs dang*// mdzes pas blta na sdug par gshegs// sa gnyis yid byed dang bral bas// mi yo drang por gshegs pa dang*// gzhan gyi yon tan brjod pas na// sha rgyas 'gying legs 'khril bag chags// sgo gsum sdig dang ma sbag pas// byi dor byas 'dra'i gtsang ba dang*// blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos ston pas// ring thung sbom phra rim par 'tsham// sgo gsum kun tu spyod gtsang bas// sku ni gtsang zhing dag pa dang*// thugs rje chen po'i thugs mnga' bas// sku ni shin tu 'jam pa dang*// dri ma maid pa'i mthu mnga' bas// shin tu rnam dag pa'i sku nyid dang*// nyon mongs 'joms pa'i chos 'dul ba// rdzogs pas mtshan bzang ni shin tu gsal// yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ yangs shing mdzes pa'i yon tan rdzogs// sku yi khyon che kho lag yang*/ shing bzang*/ sems can kun la thugs snyoms pas// gom pa che chung med par snyoms//

pa dang*/ gzhan la rnam dag chos ston pas// spyan la ra ri med par dag /dpe bcas go sla'i chos ston pas// sku ni shin tu gzhon sha can// nyid dang*/ bya dka'i gnas la ma zhum pas// sku sha zhum pa med pa dang*// dge (485)rtsa rgya chen bsags pa yis// sku sha shin tu rgyas pa dang*// gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang*/ yang srid len pa'i las zad pas// sku sha mi lhod shin tu grim pa dang*// rten 'brel 'byung ldog phye nas ston// yan lag sbom phra ring thung med/ shin tu rnam 'byed dang*// mngon mtho nges legs lam ston pas// spyan sogs dri med rnam par dag /slob ma tshul khrims phun tshogs pas// dku ste rta zur sked pa zlum// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma sbags pas// sked skabs 'tsham pas skabs phyin dang*// nga rgyal 'gying ba rnam bcom pas// sked pa mi ring sku ma rnyongs// zad mi shes pa'i chos ston pas// lto ba mtho dman med phyang nge*// ba dang*/ chos zab rtogs pas lte ba zab// pa dang*/ gdam ngag 'dzin pa'i slob ma mnga'// lte ba'i ri mo g.yas phyogs 'khyil// spyod pa mdzes pa'i 'khor mnga' bas// spyod lam kun nas blta na sdug pa dang*/ dri ma med pa'i thugs gtsang bas// sgo gsum spyod pa kun tu gtsang*// lam log dus min chos mi ston// sku la sme ba gnag bag med// zo mdog bde ba'i chos ston pas// phyag ni shing bal bzhin du 'jam// rang gzhan snyoms mdangs yod pa'i dge sbyang pa'i skye bo brnyes// phyag (486)gi ri mo mdangs yod gsal// zab mo'i chos rtogs la gnas pas// phyag ris rgyang nas gsal bas zab// yang yang yang dag chos ston pas// phyag gi ri mo ring ba dang*// bslab gzhi rgyud dang 'tshams ston pas// zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang*// chos rnams gzugs brnyan 'drar rtogs pas// mchu ni srog chags bim pa'am// shing thog bim pa'i mdog ltar dmar// gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i dwangs gsal can// 'jam po'i tshig gis ljags mnyen dang*// 'thad ldan ston pas ljags srab pa// 'dul ba ston pas ljags mi dmar// bsnyengs sam 'jigs pa mi mnga' bas// gsung ni 'brug gi sgra ltar brjid//

pa nyid dang*/ snyan zhing mnyen la 'jam por gsungs// gsung ni mnyen zhing 'jam pa dang*// chags khro nga rgyal ma rig lta// the tshom mchog 'dzin phra dog dang*// ser sna srid pa'i kun sbyor dgu// spangs bas mche ba zlum pa dang*// gdul dka' 'dul bas mche ba rno// bas/ nyon mongs 'dul bas mche ba dkar// mnyam nyid rtogs pas mche ba mnyam// pa dang*/ (487)theg gsum lam mthar gyis ston pas// mche ba rnams ni byin gyis phra// ba dang*/ thabs shes mchog la gnas pas na// shangs kyi gzengs ni mtho ba dang*// gdul bya gtsang la yid ches mnga'// mchog tu dag pa'i shangs mnga' dang*// theg pa chen po'i chos ston pas// spyan dkyus ring bas yangs pa dang*// sems can mtha' yas 'khor ba nas// drangs pas rdzi ma stug pa dang*// mgu dka'i gzhon nu mas bstod pas// spyan ni padma

'dab ma 'dra ba rgyas bzhin mdzes// ma 'ongs ci 'gyur gzigs pas na// smin tshugs shin tu ring ba dang*// lam ni 'jam pos gdul bya gdul// smin pa'i spu ni shin tu 'jam// thugs rgyud dge bas brlan pas na// smin ma'i dbu ni snum pa dang*// chags sogs nyon mongs skyon kun gzigs// smin ma spu ni ring thung med par mnyam// pa dang*/ sems can nyon mongs bzlog par mdzad// phyag ni ring zhing rgyas pa dang*// nyon mongs g.yul las rnam rgyal bas// snyan gyi che chung mnyam pas mdzes// gdul bya'i rgyud ma nyams mdzad pas// snyan gyi dbang po nyams pa rnam par spangs// lta ba ngan pas bsgyur mi nus// skra mtshams (488)legs pas dpral ba 'byes// pa dang*/ /log smra thams cad 'joms mdzad dang*// dpral ba'i dbyes sam khyon che ba// smon lam thams cad rab rdzogs pas// dbu ni gdugs ltar shin tu rgyas// yul la sred pa bzlog mdzad pas// dbu skra bung ba bzhin du gnag /bag nyal thams cad zad par spangs// dbu skra bar mtshams med par stug /rtog med blo yis snying po'i bstan// shes pas dbu skra shin tu 'jam// nyon mongs pas ni thugs ma 'khrugs// dbu skra phan tshun 'dzings pa med// tshig rtsub spangs bas mi rtsub cing*// gyen du ma brdzes pas mi gshor// dkon mchog mchod la brtson pa yis// dbu skra shin tu dri zhim pa// sku ni shin tu mdzes pa yis// thugs ka phyag zhabs mthe bong la// rdo rje'i ri mo lta bu ni// dpal gyi be'us mtshan pa dang*// phyag zhabs mthil na ri mo ni// gru bzhi pa ni bkra shis dang*// srin lag sogs la ri mo bdun// g.yas 'khyil g.yung drung 'khyil ba rnams// sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed/ mthong ba tsam gyis skyes bu yid 'phrog byed// pa dang ldan no/ bzhi pa ma nges lnga ldan pa'i// gzugs sku mthar thug sprul sku ni// bzo skye mchog gi sprul pa'i skus//

gang gi srid pa ji srid gnas kyi bar// dag dang ma dag (489)gdul bya 'gro ba la// 'phral yun phan pa sna tshogs pa// dag mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni// thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi chad par mdzad pa yin// ye shes chos sku'i bdag rkyen las// byung ba'i phrin las ni rnam pa nyi shu bdun// du bzhed/ rdzu 'phrul 'gyed dang chos ston pas// ngan song lha mi'i 'gro ba rnams// srid par zhen pa zhi nas kyang*// thar lam skye ba'i rten la 'god phrin las pa dang*// bde 'gro'i 'gro ba tshe 'dir zhen// bzlog nas bsdu dngos bzhi la 'god// thos sogs shes rab la brten nas// kun nas nyon mongs bcas pa yi/ sdug kun skyon dang 'gog lam gyi// yonatan shes rnam par byang na rtogs pa dang*/ nas bden pa bzhi'i// blang dor byed la 'god pa dang*// tshad med bzhi yi sgo nas ni// sems can rnam don ji bzhin gyi/ gzhan don rdzogs byang don dang don gnyer gyi// bsam pa phun sum tshogs la 'god// gtso bo rang rgyud smin byed du// pha rol phyin drug nyams len dang 'brel ba'i// sbyor ba phun sum tshogs la 'god// rang gzhan gnyis ka'i sangs rgyas don gyi phyir// dge bcu'i lam la 'god pa lnga// tshogs kyi lam la 'god pa'o// 'jig rten sgom byung shes rab kyis// chos rnams rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid// rtogs pa sbyor lam 'god pa yin// sbyin pa'i phar phyin la (490)brten nas// spros bral gnyis zad dang*/ chos dbyings kun 'gro'i don// rtogs pa mthong lam dang po'i bar// tshul khrims nas brtsam phar phyin bzhis// tha snyad ming gis btags pa gsum// brda' dang rtogs pa sa lnga man la 'god// shes rab lhag pas chos thams cad// dmigs med rtogs pa sa drug pa// thabs mkhas la brten lus can rnams// kyi rgyud yongs su ni smin pa sa bdun pa// stobs kyis phyin byang chub sems dpa' lam dang ni/

drug spyod pa dang*// lta ba khyad mngaun par zhen pa zlog pa dang*/ 'phags la 'god gnyis// sa brgyad pa la 'god pa yin// smon lam rdzogs pas sangs rgyas 'dra'i// byang chub thob dang chos 'khor bskor ba sa dgu pa// ye shes pha rol phyin rdzogs shing*// 'od zer chen po'i dbang thob pas// sangs rgyas zhing rnams rnam par dag byed pa// sa bcu thob ma thag la 'god// skye ba gcig gis thogs pa la// skye ba phyi ma de nyid la// zhing dus sangs rgyas 'di zhes par// 'gyur ba nges pa la 'god dang*// sangs rgyas mnyam par sems can don// tshad med sgrub la 'god pa dang*// zhing rnams bgrod cing sangs rgyas bsten// chos nyan sems can smin la sogs// yon tan la ni 'god dang (491)gsum// srid pa tha ma pa nyid la// byang chub chen po'i yon tan rnams// skye ba de nyid la 'dren pa'i// byang chub yan lag la 'god dang*// tshogs gnyis stobs kyis rdzogs byang gnyis// 'byin pas las rnams chud mi za// nges pa nyid la 'god pa dang gnyis ni// nus pa'i khyad par la 'god dang*// bden bzhi'i dngos po yang dag mthong*// ji snyed rtogs la 'god pa dang*// 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid 'dus byas 'dus mi byas pa la// tha dad yongs su mi shes dang*// du mthong*// ji ltar rtogs par 'god pa gnyis// rtogs pa'i khyad par can la 'god// gtsang sogs phyin ci log bzhi yis// bag chags spangs la 'god pa dang*// de dag dmigs pa gzhi dang bcas pa// med pa'i tshul du shes pa la// 'god pa dang gnyis ni spang pa'i khyad// tshogs gnyis sngar bsags thams cad kyang*// dri ma yongs su dag pa yi// rnam par byang bar 'god pa dang*// rnam par dag pa'i rgyu tshogs kun// tshang zhing tshogs la 'god pa dang gnyis// ni// dag pa'i rgyu tshogs la 'god pa// sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa// mtha' dag yongs su zad nas kyang*// mi gnas pa yi mya ngan 'das// 'das pa sangs rgyas sa la (492)'god// lam gyi 'bras bur 'god pa yin// 'di la sa brgyad par byang chub// lam sogs shes dang mngon zhen bzlog

/byang chub dam pa rtsol med thob// sangs rgyas zhing rnam dag dang bzhi// sa dgur skye ba gcig nges dang*// sems can don sgrub gnyis pa ni// sa bcur sangs rgyas bsten la sogs// 'jam mgon a dzi tas sbyar ro// dngos po brgyad kyi grangs nges ni// nyams su blang bya mkhyen pa gsum// nyams su len byed sbyor ba bzhi// nyams su blang 'bras chos skur nges// mkhyen pa gsum gyi grangs nges kyang*// shing*// de la mkhyen gsum rnam pa la// dbang thob don du rnam rdzogs sbyor// dbang thob zin nas rtse sbyor du// grangs nges rtogs pa mthar thub gi// lag rjes 'jog byed phyi ma gnyis// mkhyen pa skad
